passage.title: Asking for a Day Off Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克下週五有一場重要的期中考試。但他那天下午原本要排班打工。他需要向經理請假。他提前找了大衛來幫他代班。他去找經理說明情況並請求批准。
passage.en: Manager, are you free right now? I'd like to talk to you about next week's schedule. I'm free. What's wrong, Mark? Is there a problem with the schedule? Next Friday afternoon I have a very important midterm exam, so I want to ask for a half-day leave. Next Friday afternoon is the busiest time in the shop. If you take leave, we might be short-handed. I know. So I have already discussed it with David; he is willing to cover my shift that afternoon. David? Didn't he originally have no shift that day? Right, he happens to be resting that day. We swapped shifts; I will work for him next Sunday.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫一封請假訊息給經理：包含請假日期、原因以及你找了誰代班（40 到 60 個字）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '替 (tì)' 表示替代或代替。'既然...那就...' 表示基於已發生的事實得出結論。'以...為重' 表示將某事視為最重要。
examples: 我替你去。 (I'll go in your place.)
既然你來了，那就坐吧。 (Since you're here, then take a seat.)
以健康為重。 (Health comes first.)
商量好了 (Discussed and settled)
人手不夠 (Short-handed)

practice.q: Complete: ____然你不想去，那就別去了。 (Since...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 大衛，你這週末能替我上個夜班嗎？我突然有點事。
expansion_dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ zhè zhōu mò néng tì wǒ shàng gè yè bān ma? wǒ tū rán yǒu diǎn shì.
expansion_dialogue.en: David, can you cover a night shift for me this weekend? Something came up suddenly.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這週末？可是我已經約了朋友吃飯。很急嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè zhōu mò? kě shì wǒ yǐ jīng yuē le péng you chī fàn. hěn jí ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: This weekend? But I've already made plans to eat with a friend. Is it very urgent?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對，我家裡出了點急事，必須回去一趟。拜託了！
expansion_dialogue.py: duì, wǒ jiā lǐ chū le diǎn jí shì, bì xū huí qù yī tàng. bài tuō le!
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, an urgent matter came up at home; I must go back for a trip. Please!

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好吧，那我跟朋友改期。你去忙你的吧，夜班交給我。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo ba, nà wǒ gēn péng you gǎi qī. nǐ qù máng nǐ de ba, yè bān jiāo gěi wǒ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay then, I'll reschedule with my friend. Go handle your business; leave the night shift to me.

title: Work Schedule Change
story_description: 馬克因為私人原因，需要和同事大衛商量交換排班。
story_intro: 馬克看了下週的工作班表。
他發現週四的班和他的社團活動衝突了。
他找到同事大衛，想商量換班。
大衛看了看自己的時間表。
他們成功地達成了一致。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，你在看下週的班表嗎？
dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ zài kàn xià zhōu de bān biǎo ma?
dialogue.en: David, are you looking at next week's schedule?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對啊，我下週有三個早班和一個晚班。怎麼了？
dialogue.py: duì a, wǒ xià zhōu yǒu sān gè zǎo bān hé yī gè wǎn bān. zěn me le?
dialogue.en: Yeah, I have three morning shifts and one evening shift next week. What's up?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我下週四被排了下午班，但是那天我的攝影社有重要的外拍活動。
dialogue.py: wǒ xià zhōu sì bèi pái le xià wǔ bān, dàn shì nà tiān wǒ de shè yǐng shè yǒu zhòng yào de wài pāi huó dòng.
dialogue.en: I'm scheduled for an afternoon shift next Thursday, but my photography club has an important outdoor shoot that day.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 所以你想跟我換班？
dialogue.py: suǒ yǐ nǐ xiǎng gēn wǒ huàn bān?
dialogue.en: So you want to swap shifts with me?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，不知道你週四下午有沒有空？我可以替你上週三的早班。
dialogue.py: duì, bù zhī dào nǐ zhōu sì xià wǔ yǒu méi yǒu kòng? wǒ kě yǐ tì nǐ shàng zhōu sān de zǎo bān.
dialogue.en: Yes, I don't know if you are free on Thursday afternoon? I can cover your Wednesday morning shift.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 讓我看看...週四下午我正好沒課，可以替你上。可是週三早班我不想換。
dialogue.py: ràng wǒ kàn kan... zhōu sì xià wǔ wǒ zhèng hǎo méi kè, kě yǐ tì nǐ shàng. kě shì zhōu sān zǎo bān wǒ bù xiǎng huàn.
dialogue.en: Let me see... I happen to have no class on Thursday afternoon; I can cover for you. But I don't want to swap the Wednesday morning shift.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？週三早班不好嗎？
dialogue.py: wèi shén me? zhōu sān zǎo bān bù hǎo ma?
dialogue.en: Why? Is the Wednesday morning shift bad?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那天早上我要交一份報告，怕起不來。要不你替我上週六的晚班吧？
dialogue.py: nà tiān zǎo shang wǒ yào jiāo yī fèn bào gào, pà qǐ bù lái. yào bù nǐ tì wǒ shàng zhōu liù de wǎn bān ba?
dialogue.en: I have to hand in a report that morning; I'm afraid I won't be able to wake up. How about you cover my Saturday evening shift?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 週六晚班...從晚上六點到十點對吧？可以，成交！
dialogue.py: zhōu liù wǎn bān... cóng wǎn shang liù diǎn dào shí diǎn duì ba? kě yǐ, chéng jiāo!
dialogue.en: Saturday evening shift... from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM, right? Okay, deal!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那我們等一下去找經理，把換班的事情告訴他。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le. nà wǒ men děng yī xià qù zhǎo jīng lǐ, bǎ huàn bān de shì qing gào su tā.
dialogue.en: Great. Then we'll go find the manager in a bit and tell him about the shift swap.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。真的很感謝你幫我這個忙。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. zhēn de hěn gǎn xiè nǐ bāng wǒ zhè ge máng.
dialogue.en: Okay. I really appreciate you doing me this favor.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 同事之間互相幫忙是應該的。外拍記得多拍點好照片！
dialogue.py: tóng shì zhī jiān hù xiāng bāng máng shì yīng gāi de. wài pāi jì de duō pāi diǎn hǎo zhào piàn!
dialogue.en: Helping each other between coworkers is what should be done. Remember to take lots of good photos on your shoot!

Cover the morning shift for you.

expansion_dialogue.py: jīng lǐ, zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng qǐng jià, kě yǐ ma?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.py: zhè ge zhōu mò diàn lǐ yǒu cù xiāo huó dòng, fēi cháng quē rén. nǐ zhǎo dào rén dài bān le ma?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.en: You can ask in the group chat first; if someone is willing to swap shifts, I will approve it.

title: Workplace Mistake
story_description: 馬克在咖啡廳打工時不小心做錯了客人的飲料。他誠懇地道歉並迅速解決了問題。
story_intro: 今天是週末，咖啡廳裡的客人很多。
馬克在吧檯忙著做飲料。
他不小心把一位客人的熱拿鐵做成了冰拿鐵。
客人來取餐時發現了錯誤。
馬克立即道歉並重新製作。

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，這杯拿鐵好像做錯了。我點的是熱的，但這杯是冰的。
dialogue.py: bù hǎo yì si, zhè bēi ná tiě hǎo xiàng zuò cuò le. wǒ diǎn de shì rè de, dàn zhè bēi shì bīng de.
dialogue.en: Excuse me, it seems this latte was made incorrectly. I ordered a hot one, but this cup is iced.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 啊，非常抱歉！我看錯了點單系統上的標籤。
dialogue.py: ā, fēi cháng bào qiàn! wǒ kàn cuò le diǎn dān xì tǒng shàng de biāo qiān.
dialogue.en: Ah, I am very sorry! I misread the label on the ordering system.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，那現在能幫我換一杯熱的嗎？
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, nà xiàn zài néng bāng wǒ huàn yī bēi rè de ma?
dialogue.en: It's okay, then can you change it to a hot one for me now?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。真對不起，耽誤您的時間了。我馬上為您重新做一杯。
dialogue.py: dāng rán kě yǐ. zhēn duì bù qǐ, dān wù nín de shí jiān le. wǒ mǎ shàng wèi nín chóng xīn zuò yī bēi.
dialogue.en: Of course. I'm really sorry to have delayed your time. I will remake a cup for you right away.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 大概需要等多久？我等一下還約了人。
dialogue.py: dà gài xū yào děng duō jiǔ? wǒ děng yī xià hái yuē le rén.
dialogue.en: Roughly how long do I need to wait? I have an appointment with someone in a bit.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 只要三分鐘。請您在旁邊稍等一下，這杯馬上就好。
dialogue.py: zhǐ yào sān fēn zhōng. qǐng nín zài páng biān shāo děng yī xià, zhè bēi mǎ shàng jiù hǎo.
dialogue.en: Only three minutes. Please wait on the side for a moment; this cup will be ready immediately.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 好的，謝謝。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, xiè xie.
dialogue.en: Okay, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （三分鐘後）小姐，這是您的熱拿鐵。為了表達歉意，這塊手工餅乾送給您品嚐。
dialogue.py: (sān fēn zhōng hòu) xiǎo jiě, zhè shì nín de rè ná tiě. wèi le biǎo dá qiàn yì, zhè kuài shǒu gōng bǐng gān sòng gěi nín pǐn cháng.
dialogue.en: (Three minutes later) Miss, this is your hot latte. To express my apology, this handmade cookie is given to you to taste.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 哇，太客氣了。謝謝你的處理，態度很好。
dialogue.py: wa, tài kè qì le. xiè xie nǐ de chǔ lǐ, tài duō hěn hǎo.
dialogue.en: Wow, you're too kind. Thanks for your handling; the attitude is very good.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這是我應該做的。祝您今天愉快！
dialogue.py: zhè shì wǒ yīng gāi zuò de. zhù nín jīn tiān yú kuài!
dialogue.en: This is what I should do. Wish you a pleasant day today!

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，再見。
dialogue.py: xiè xie, zài jiàn.
dialogue.en: Thanks, goodbye.

key_sentences.en: Can you change a cup for me?
In order to express an apology.
This is what I should do.

passage.title: Workplace Mistake Listening Passage
passage.zh: 今天是週末，咖啡廳裡的客人很多。馬克在吧檯忙著做飲料。他不小心把一位客人的熱拿鐵做成了冰拿鐵。客人來取餐時發現了錯誤。馬克立即道歉並重新製作。
passage.en: Excuse me, it seems this latte was made incorrectly. I ordered a hot one, but this cup is iced. Ah, I am very sorry! I misread the label on the ordering system. It's okay, then can you change it to a hot one for me now? Of course. I'm really sorry to have delayed your time. I will remake a cup for you right away. Roughly how long do I need to wait? I have an appointment with someone in a bit. Only three minutes. Please wait on the side for a moment; this cup will be ready immediately. Okay, thanks.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫一封簡短的道歉信給客戶：說明你弄錯了訂單，對耽誤他們的時間表示歉意，並說明你會如何補救（40 到 60 個字）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 'V + 錯' 作為結果補語表示做錯了某事 (看錯、做錯)。'為了...' 表達目的。'這是我應該做的' 是常見的客氣回應。
examples: 我聽錯了。 (I misheard.)
為了學習中文，他來到了台灣。 (In order to learn Chinese, he came to Taiwan.)
耽誤時間 (Delay time)
重新開始 (Start anew)
表達歉意 (Express apology)

practice.q: Complete: ___了健康，你要多運動。 (For the sake of...)
Translate: I will remake one portion.
Complete: 真抱歉，耽___了您的時間。 (Delayed...)
Translate: This is what I should do.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 經理，對不起，我剛才不小心打破了一個杯子。
expansion_dialogue.py: jīng lǐ, duì bù qǐ, wǒ gāng cái bù xiǎo xīn dǎ pò le yī gè bēi zi.
expansion_dialogue.en: Manager, I'm sorry, I accidentally broke a cup just now.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 人沒受傷吧？
expansion_dialogue.py: rén méi shòu shāng ba?
expansion_dialogue.en: Are you hurt?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我沒事。我會賠償杯子的費用的。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ méi shì. wǒ huì péi cháng bēi zi de fèi yòng de.
expansion_dialogue.en: I'm fine. I will compensate for the cost of the cup.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 不用賠了，下次工作時小心一點就好。先把碎片清理乾淨，別讓客人踩到。
expansion_dialogue.py: bù yòng péi le, xià cì gōng zuò shí xiǎo xīn yī diǎn jiù hǎo. xiān bǎ suì piàn qīng lǐ gān jìng, bié ràng kè rén cǎi dào.
expansion_dialogue.en: No need to compensate; just be a bit more careful when working next time. Clean up the shards first, don't let customers step on them.

review.speaking: Apologize for a mistake at work and offer a solution.
review.writing: Write a 40-word workplace apology.
review.self_check: 你能用中文承認錯誤、誠懇道歉並提出補救措施嗎？

title: Review Story: Student Life and First Job
story_description: 馬克在學期末回顧了他這段時間的生活，包括學業、住宿、旅行和第一份兼職工作。
story_intro: Stage 4 即將結束，馬克的大學生活也越來越豐富。
他搬出了宿舍，自己租了房子。
他在圖書館找到了一份兼職工作。
他學會了在遇到困難時與老師和老闆溝通。
他用中文寫了一篇回顧短文，總結他的成長。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 時間過得真快！這幾個月我經歷了很多'第一次'。
dialogue.py: shí jiān guò de zhēn kuài! zhè jǐ gè yuè wǒ jīng lì le hěn duō 'dì yī cì'.
dialogue.en: Time flies! These past few months I've experienced many 'firsts'.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我第一次在校外租房。雖然找房子的過程有點兒吃力，還要跟房東簽合同。
dialogue.py: wǒ dì yī cì zài xiào wài zū fáng. suī rán zhǎo fáng zi de guò chéng yǒu diǎn r chī lì, hái yào gēn fáng dōng qiān hé tong.
dialogue.en: My first time renting off-campus. Although the process of house hunting was a bit strenuous, and I had to sign a contract with the landlord.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 但現在我有了自己獨立的房間，採光很好，住得很舒服。
dialogue.py: dàn xiàn zài wǒ yǒu le zì jǐ dú lì de fáng jiān, cǎi guāng hěn hǎo, zhù de hěn shū fu.
dialogue.en: But now I have my own independent room, the lighting is very good, and it's comfortable to live in.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 在學業上，我的中文進步了不少。我甚至能用中文做課堂演講了！
dialogue.py: zài xué yè shàng, wǒ de zhōng wén jìn bù le bù shǎo. wǒ shèn zhì néng yòng zhōng wén zuò kè táng yǎn jiǎng le!
dialogue.en: Academically, my Chinese has improved a lot. I can even do class presentations in Chinese now!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛幫了我很多，我們經常一起在圖書館複習重點。
dialogue.py: dà wèi bāng le wǒ hěn duō, wǒ men jīng cháng yī qǐ zài tú shū guǎn fù xí zhòng diǎn.
dialogue.en: David helped me a lot; we often review the key points together in the library.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我也開始在咖啡廳打工。這是我第一次在國外做兼職。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě kāi shǐ zài kā fēi tīng dǎ gōng. zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì zài guó wài zuò jiān zhí.
dialogue.en: I also started working part-time at a coffee shop. This is my first time doing a part-time job abroad.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 剛開始我很緊張，還把客人的飲料做錯了。
dialogue.py: gāng kāi shǐ wǒ hěn jǐn zhāng, hái bǎ kè rén de yǐn liào zuò cuò le.
dialogue.en: At first I was very nervous, and even made a customer's drink wrong.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 但經理很體諒我。現在我已經能熟練地操作收銀機，也能和客人禮貌地溝通了。
dialogue.py: dàn jīng lǐ hěn tǐ liàng wǒ. xiàn zài wǒ yǐ jīng néng shú liàn de cāo zuò shōu yín jī, yě néng hé kè rén lǐ mào de gōu tōng le.
dialogue.en: But the manager was very understanding. Now I can skillfully operate the cash register, and can communicate politely with customers.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 當我遇到考試和排班衝突時，我學會了主動找同事換班。
dialogue.py: dāng wǒ yù dào kǎo shì hé pái bān chōng tū shí, wǒ xué huì le zhǔ dòng zhǎo tóng shì huàn bān.
dialogue.en: When I encountered a conflict between an exam and scheduling, I learned to proactively find a coworker to swap shifts.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我覺得自己變得更獨立、更有責任感了。
dialogue.py: wǒ jué de zì jǐ biàn de gèng dú lì, gèng yǒu zé rèn gǎn le.
dialogue.en: I feel I have become more independent and more responsible.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 接下來的 Stage 5，我相信會遇到更難的對話和任務。
dialogue.py: jiē xià lái de Stage 5, wǒ xiāng xìn huì yù dào gèng nán de duì huà hé rèn wu.
dialogue.en: In the upcoming Stage 5, I believe I will encounter harder dialogues and tasks.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 但我不怕。只要保持熱情，努力練習，一定能克服困難！
dialogue.py: dàn wǒ bù pà. zhǐ yào bǎo chí rè qíng, nǔ lì liàn xí, yī dìng néng kè fú kùn nán!
dialogue.en: But I'm not afraid. As long as I maintain passion and practice hard, I can definitely overcome the difficulties!

key_sentences.en: Proactively find a coworker to swap shifts.

vocabulary.example: 他很生氣，甚至不想說話。
他是一個有責任感的人。

passage.zh: Stage4即將結束，馬克的大學生活也越來越豐富。他搬出了宿舍，自己租了房子。他在圖書館找到了一份兼職工作。他學會了在遇到困難時與老師和老闆溝通。他用中文寫了一篇回顧短文，總結他的成長。

grammar.explanation: Review Stage 4: '甚至' (even to the extent), '把...做錯了' (disposal structure + result), '熟練地' (adverbial marker 地), '只要...一定能...' (conditional guarantee).
examples: 他甚至會說法語。 (He can even speak French.)
我把名字寫錯了。 (I wrote the name wrong.)
熟練地工作 (Work skillfully)
主動地學習 (Study proactively)
只要努力，一定能贏。 (As long as you try hard, you will definitely win.)

practice.q: Translate: I even know his address.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 恭喜你順利完成了這學期的所有任務！
expansion_dialogue.py: gōng xǐ nǐ shùn lì wán chéng le zhè xué qī de suǒ yǒu rèn wu!
expansion_dialogue.en: Congratulations on smoothly completing all tasks this semester!

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.py: xiè xie! huí tóu kàn, gāng kāi xué shí wǒ hái shén me dōu bù dǒng ne.
expansion_dialogue.en: Thanks! Looking back, I didn't know anything at all when school just started.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.py: zhè shuō míng nǐ jìn bù hěn kuài, fù chū yǒu le huí bào.
expansion_dialogue.en: This shows you've improved very quickly; your effort has paid off.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對，下學期我希望能參加更多的實踐活動，挑戰自己。
expansion_dialogue.py: duì, xià xué qī wǒ xī wàng néng cān jiā gèng duō de shí jiàn huó dòng, tiǎo zhàn zì jǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, next semester I hope to participate in more practical activities to challenge myself.

title: Choosing a Course
story_description: 馬克正在與選課指導老師討論下學期的課程。他猶豫不決，老師給了他一些建議。
story_intro: 下學期的選課即將開始。
馬克不知道該選什麼專業課。
他預約了指導老師的時間。
他們討論了馬克的興趣和未來的職業規劃。
老師幫助他做出了決定。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老師您好，我是馬克。我預約了今天下午來討論下學期的選課。
dialogue.py: lǎo shī nín hǎo, wǒ shì mǎ kè. wǒ yù yuē le jīn tiān xià wǔ lái tǎo lùn xià xué qī de xuǎn kè.
dialogue.en: Hello Teacher, I am Mark. I made an appointment to come discuss next semester's course selection this afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 你好，馬克，請坐。我看了一下你的成績單，你上學期的基礎經濟學考得不錯。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, mǎ kè, qǐng zuò. wǒ kàn le yī xià nǐ de chéng jì dān, nǐ shàng xué qī de jī chǔ jīng jì xué kǎo de bù cuò.
dialogue.en: Hello, Mark, please sit. I looked at your transcript; you did quite well in basic economics last semester.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師。我對經濟學很感興趣，所以下學期想多選一些相關的課程。
dialogue.py: xiè xie lǎo shī. wǒ duì jīng jì xué hěn gǎn xìng qù, suǒ yǐ xià xué qī xiǎng duō xuǎn yī xiē xiāng guān de kè chéng.
dialogue.en: Thank you, Teacher. I am very interested in economics, so next semester I want to choose a few more related courses.

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 很好。你打算畢業後往哪個方向發展？是繼續深造，還是直接找工作？
dialogue.py: hěn hǎo. nǐ dǎ suàn bì yè hòu wǎng nǎ ge fāng xiàng fā zhǎn? shì jì xù shēn zào, hái shì zhí jiē zhǎo gōng zuò?
dialogue.en: Very good. Which direction do you plan to develop in after graduation? Is it to continue further studies, or to look for a job directly?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我打算先工作幾年，積累一些實務經驗，可能會去金融公司。
dialogue.py: wǒ dǎ suàn xiān gōng zuò jǐ nián, jī lěi yī xiē shí wù jīng yàn, kě néng huì qù jīn róng gōng sī.
dialogue.en: I plan to work for a few years first, accumulate some practical experience, and might go to a financial company.

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 既然你想進入金融業，我強烈建議你選修『國際金融』和『數據分析』。
dialogue.py: jì rán nǐ xiǎng jìn rù jīn róng yè, wǒ qiáng liè jiàn yì nǐ xuǎn xiū 'guó jì jīn róng' hé 'shù jù fēn xī'.
dialogue.en: Since you want to enter the financial industry, I strongly recommend you take 'International Finance' and 'Data Analysis'.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 『數據分析』聽起來很實用，但是聽說這門課的作業非常多，很難及格。
dialogue.py: 'shù jù fēn xī' tīng qǐ lái hěn shí yòng, dàn shì tīng shuō zhè mén kè de zuò yè fēi cháng duō, hěn nán jí gé.
dialogue.en: 'Data Analysis' sounds very practical, but I've heard this course has a lot of homework and it's hard to pass.

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 這門課確實有挑戰性，但它能教你如何使用軟體處理大量數據，這對未來的面試很有幫助。
dialogue.py: zhè mén kè què shí yǒu tiǎo zhàn xìng, dàn tā néng jiāo nǐ rú hé shǐ yòng ruǎn tǐ chǔ lǐ dà liàng shù jù, zhè duì wèi lái de miàn shì hěn yǒu bāng zhù.
dialogue.en: This course is indeed challenging, but it can teach you how to use software to process large amounts of data, which is very helpful for future interviews.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我明白了。那除了這兩門課，我還需要選一門選修課。您覺得『企業管理』怎麼樣？
dialogue.py: wǒ míng bai le. nà chú le zhè liǎng mén kè, wǒ hái xū yào xuǎn yī mén xuǎn xiū kè. nín jué de 'qǐ yè guǎn lǐ' zěn me yàng?
dialogue.en: I understand. Then besides these two courses, I still need to choose one elective course. What do you think about 'Business Management'?

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 『企業管理』比較偏重理論。如果你想多學點實際操作，『市場行銷』可能會更好。
dialogue.py: 'qǐ yè guǎn lǐ' bǐ jiào piān zhòng lǐ lùn. rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng duō xué diǎn shí jì cāo zuò, 'shì chǎng xíng xiāo' kě néng huì gèng hǎo.
dialogue.en: 'Business Management' is more focused on theory. If you want to learn a bit more practical operation, 'Marketing' might be better.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 『市場行銷』？我以前沒考慮過，但聽起來很有趣。
dialogue.py: 'shì chǎng xíng xiāo'? wǒ yǐ qián méi kǎo lǜ guò, dàn tīng qǐ lái hěn yǒu qù.
dialogue.en: 'Marketing'? I hadn't considered it before, but it sounds very interesting.

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 是的，你可以去聽第一節課試試看。如果一週後覺得不適合，還可以退選。
dialogue.py: shì de, nǐ kě yǐ qù tīng dì yī jié kè shì shi kàn. rú guǒ yī zhōu hòu jué de bù shì hé, hái kě yǐ tuì xuǎn.
dialogue.en: Yes, you can go listen to the first class and try it out. If after a week you feel it's not suitable, you can still drop it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，那我就先選這三門課。謝謝老師的指導！
dialogue.py: hǎo de, nà wǒ jiù xiān xuǎn zhè sān mén kè. xiè xie lǎo shī de zhǐ dǎo!
dialogue.en: Okay, then I will choose these three courses first. Thank you for your guidance, Teacher!

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。如果有其他問題，隨時歡迎再來找我。
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. rú guǒ yǒu qí tā wèn tí, suí shí huān yíng zài lái zhǎo wǒ.
dialogue.en: You're welcome. If you have other questions, you are welcome to come find me anytime.

passage.title: Choosing a Course Listening Passage
passage.zh: 下學期的選課即將開始。馬克不知道該選什麼專業課。他預約了指導老師的時間。他們討論了馬克的興趣和未來的職業規劃。老師幫助他做出了決定。
passage.en: Hello Teacher, I am Mark. I made an appointment to come discuss next semester's course selection this afternoon. Hello, Mark, please sit. I looked at your transcript; you did quite well in basic economics last semester. Thank you, Teacher. I am very interested in economics, so next semester I want to choose a few more related courses. Very good. Which direction do you plan to develop in after graduation? Is it to continue further studies, or to look for a job directly? I plan to work for a few years first, accumulate some practical experience, and might go to a financial company. Since you want to enter the financial industry, I strongly recommend you take 'International Finance' and 'Data Analysis'. 'Data Analysis' sounds very practical, but I've heard this course has a lot of homework and it's hard to pass.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字，描述你下學期或明年想學習什麼新技能或課程。為什麼想學？你希望這能為你的未來帶來什麼幫助？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '除了...還...' 表示在包含前者的基礎上，加上後者 (Besides A, also B)。'往...方向' 表示朝著某個目標或領域發展。
examples: 除了英語，我還會說中文。 (Besides English, I can also speak Chinese.)
除了週末，我每天都運動。 (Besides weekends, I exercise every day.)
他想往醫學方向發展。 (He wants to develop in the medical direction.)
積累經驗 (Accumulate experience)
對...有幫助 (Helpful for...)

expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ zhè xué qī xuǎn le jǐ xué fēn de kè?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ xuǎn le èr shí xué fēn, gǎn jué yǒu diǎn chī lì. měi tiān dōu yǒu hěn duō yuè dú zuò yè.
expansion_dialogue.en: I chose twenty credits; I feel a bit overwhelmed. There are many reading assignments every day.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 二十學分太多了。你應該退掉一門課，不然期末考會很慘。
expansion_dialogue.py: èr shí xué fēn tài duō le. nǐ yīng gāi tuì diào yī mén kè, bù rán qī mò kǎo huì hěn cǎn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Twenty credits are too much. You should drop a course, otherwise the final exams will be miserable.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我正在考慮退掉『歐洲歷史』。那門課對我來說太深奧了。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ zhèng zài kǎo lǜ tuì diào 'ōu zhōu lì shǐ'. nà mén kè duì wǒ lái shuō tài shēn ào le.
expansion_dialogue.en: I am considering dropping 'European History'. That course is too profound for me.

title: Changing a Class
story_description: 馬克發現他選的歷史課和打工時間衝突了。他去辦公室申請換到另一個時間的班級。
story_intro: 開學的第一週，馬克拿到了正式的課表。
他發現週四下午的歷史課和咖啡廳的排班衝突了。
如果他不換課，就必須辭職。
他急忙來到學校的教務處。
他希望能換到週二上午的歷史班。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，請問這裡是負責處理換課申請的櫃檯嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, qǐng wèn zhè lǐ shì fù zé chǔ lǐ huàn kè shēn qǐng de guì tái ma?
dialogue.en: Hello, excuse me, is this the counter responsible for handling class change applications?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 是的。同學，你需要辦理什麼業務？
dialogue.py: shì de. tóng xué, nǐ xū yào bàn lǐ shén me yè wù?
dialogue.en: Yes. Student, what business do you need to process?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想申請更換『世界歷史』的班級。我現在被分在週四下午的班。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng shēn qǐng gēng huàn 'shì jiè lì shǐ' de bān jí. wǒ xiàn zài bèi fēn zài zhōu sì xià wǔ de bān.
dialogue.en: I want to apply to change the 'World History' class. I am currently assigned to the Thursday afternoon class.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 請給我你的學生證。為什麼想換班呢？是對老師不滿意嗎？
dialogue.py: qǐng gěi wǒ nǐ de xué sheng zhèng. wèi shén me xiǎng huàn bān ne? shì duì lǎo shī bù mǎn yì ma?
dialogue.en: Please give me your student ID. Why do you want to change classes? Are you dissatisfied with the teacher?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不是的。是因為這個時間和我的校外打工發生了嚴重衝突。
dialogue.py: bù shì de. shì yīn wèi zhè ge shí jiān hé wǒ de xiào wài dǎ gōng fā shēng le yán zhòng chōng tū.
dialogue.en: No. It's because this time has a serious conflict with my off-campus part-time job.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 明白了。你想換到哪個時間的班級？
dialogue.py: míng bai le. nǐ xiǎng huàn dào nǎ ge shí jiān de bān jí?
dialogue.en: Understood. Which time class do you want to change to?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我在系統上看到，週二上午有一節同樣的歷史課。我可以換到那個班嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ zài xì tǒng shàng kàn dào, zhōu èr shàng wǔ yǒu yī jié tóng yàng de lì shǐ kè. wǒ kě yǐ huàn dào nà ge bān ma?
dialogue.en: I saw on the system that there is the same history class on Tuesday morning. Can I change to that class?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 我幫你查一下...週二上午的班級目前已經滿了，沒有名額。
dialogue.py: wǒ bāng nǐ chá yī xià... zhōu èr shàng wǔ de bān jí mù qián yǐ jīng mǎn le, méi yǒu míng é.
dialogue.en: Let me check for you... The Tuesday morning class is currently full; there is no quota.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 滿了？那怎麼辦？如果不能換課，我就得放棄那份工作了。
dialogue.py: mǎn le? nà zěn me bàn? rú guǒ bù néng huàn kè, wǒ jiù děi fàng qì nà fèn gōng zuò le.
dialogue.en: Full? Then what should I do? If I can't change the class, I will have to give up that job.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 別急，我看到週五早上的班級還有兩個空位，老師是王教授。那個時間可以嗎？
dialogue.py: bié jí, wǒ kàn dào zhōu wǔ zǎo shang de bān jí hái yǒu liǎng gè kòng wèi, lǎo shī shì wáng jiào shòu. nà ge shí jiān kě yǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Don't rush, I see that the Friday morning class still has two empty seats; the teacher is Professor Wang. Is that time okay?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 週五早上...我看一下課表。太好了，那天上午我正好沒課！
dialogue.py: zhōu wǔ zǎo shang... wǒ kàn yī xià kè biǎo. tài hǎo le, nà tiān shàng wǔ wǒ zhèng hǎo méi kè!
dialogue.en: Friday morning... Let me look at the class schedule. Great, I happen to have no class that morning!

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 好，那我現在幫你辦理轉班手續。請你在這張申請表上簽名。
dialogue.py: hǎo, nà wǒ xiàn zài bāng nǐ bàn lǐ zhuǎn bān shǒu xù. qǐng nǐ zài zhè zhāng shēn qǐng biǎo shàng qiān míng.
dialogue.en: Okay, then I will process the class transfer procedure for you now. Please sign on this application form.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 簽好了。請問下週就可以直接去新班級上課了嗎？
dialogue.py: qiān hǎo le. qǐng wèn xià zhōu jiù kě yǐ zhí jiē qù xīn bān jí shàng kè le ma?
dialogue.en: Signed. May I ask if I can go directly to the new class to attend class next week?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 對，系統明天會更新你的課表。記得去跟新老師打個招呼。
dialogue.py: duì, xì tǒng míng tiān huì gēng xīn nǐ de kè biǎo. jì de qù gēn xīn lǎo shī dǎ gè zhāo hu.
dialogue.en: Yes, the system will update your class schedule tomorrow. Remember to go say hi to the new teacher.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我會的。非常感謝您的幫忙，解決了我一個大麻煩！
dialogue.py: wǒ huì de. fēi cháng gǎn xiè nín de bāng máng, jiě jué le wǒ yī gè dà má fan!
dialogue.en: I will. Thank you very much for your help; it solved a big trouble for me!

passage.title: Changing a Class Listening Passage
passage.zh: 開學的第一週，馬克拿到了正式的課表。他發現週四下午的歷史課和咖啡廳的排班衝突了。如果他不換課，就必須辭職。他急忙來到學校的教務處。他希望能換到週二上午的歷史班。
passage.en: Hello, excuse me, is this the counter responsible for handling class change applications? Yes. Student, what business do you need to process? I want to apply to change the 'World History' class. I am currently assigned to the Thursday afternoon class. Please give me your student ID. Why do you want to change classes? Are you dissatisfied with the teacher? No. It's because this time has a serious conflict with my off-campus part-time job. Understood. Which time class do you want to change to? I saw on the system that there is the same history class on Tuesday morning. Can I change to that class?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫一封 70 到 100 個字的電子郵件給學校教務處。說明你的姓名、學號，以及你想換課的原因（例如時間衝突或程度不合），並詢問還有哪些班級有空位。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '和...發生衝突' 表達時間上的不一致。'得 (děi)' 表示必須、不得不。'解決了...麻煩' 是一個常見的動賓搭配。
examples: 我的會議和航班時間發生了衝突。 (My meeting and flight times conflicted.)
太晚了，我得走了。 (It's too late; I have to go.)
你幫我解決了一個大麻煩。 (You helped me solve a big trouble.)
辦理手續 (Process procedures)
放棄機會 (Give up an opportunity)

practice.q: Translate: The time has a conflict.
Complete: 這裡沒有空___了。 (Empty seat.)
Translate: I have to give up this job.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 老師，請問我可以重修這門課嗎？我上學期沒及格。
expansion_dialogue.py: lǎo shī, qǐng wèn wǒ kě yǐ chóng xiū zhè mén kè ma? wǒ shàng xué qī méi jí gé.
expansion_dialogue.en: Teacher, excuse me, can I retake this course? I didn't pass last semester.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 可以重修。不過這學期的名額很緊張，你必須今天就去系統裡搶課。
expansion_dialogue.py: kě yǐ chóng xiū. bù guò zhè xué qī de míng é hěn jǐn zhāng, nǐ bì xū jīn tiān jiù qù xì tǒng lǐ qiǎng kè.
expansion_dialogue.en: You can retake it. However, the quota is very tight this semester; you must go grab the class in the system today.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 如果系統上選不到怎麼辦？
expansion_dialogue.py: rú guǒ xì tǒng shàng xuǎn bù dào zěn me bàn?
expansion_dialogue.en: What if I can't select it on the system?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你可以填寫紙本的加簽單，然後拿來給我簽名。我會幫你安排的。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ kě yǐ tián xiě zhǐ běn de jiā qiān dān, rán hòu ná lái gěi wǒ qiān míng. wǒ huì bāng nǐ ān pái de.
expansion_dialogue.en: You can fill out a paper add-course form, and then bring it to me to sign. I will help arrange it for you.

title: Study Group Plan
story_description: 馬克和幾位同學決定組織一個每週的讀書小組。他們正在討論聚會的時間、地點和規則。
story_intro: 經濟學的期中考試快到了。
馬克、大衛和莉莉覺得一個人讀書效率不高。
他們決定組成一個讀書小組。
他們在圖書館的討論室開會。
他們需要定下每週聚會的時間和一些基本規則。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 既然大家都同意組成讀書小組，我們就來定一下具體的計畫吧。
dialogue.py: jì rán dà jiā dōu tóng yì zǔ chéng dú shū xiǎo zǔ, wǒ men jiù lái dìng yī xià jù tǐ de jì huà ba.
dialogue.en: Since everyone agrees to form a study group, let's set a specific plan.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好。我覺得我們每週至少要見面兩次，這樣才能把所有的進度複習完。
dialogue.py: hǎo. wǒ jué de wǒ men měi zhōu zhì shǎo yào jiàn miàn liǎng cì, zhè yàng cái néng bǎ suǒ yǒu de jìn dù fù xí wán.
dialogue.en: Okay. I think we need to meet at least twice a week; this way we can finish reviewing all the progress.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 每週兩次？我週一到週三都要打工，可能沒辦法配合。每週一次，每次三個小時怎麼樣？
dialogue.py: měi zhōu liǎng cì? wǒ zhōu yī dào zhōu sān dōu yào dǎ gōng, kě néng méi bàn fǎ pèi hé. měi zhōu yī cì, měi cì sān gè xiǎo shí zěn me yàng?
dialogue.en: Twice a week? I have to work part-time from Monday to Wednesday; I might not be able to cooperate. How about once a week, three hours each time?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 每週一次也可以。那我們定在週四晚上，還是週六下午？
dialogue.py: měi zhōu yī cì yě kě yǐ. nà wǒ men dìng zài zhōu sì wǎn shang, hái shì zhōu liù xià wǔ?
dialogue.en: Once a week is also fine. Then should we set it for Thursday night, or Saturday afternoon?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 週六下午吧，大家週末比較有精神。地點就在圖書館的三樓討論室，安靜又有白板。
dialogue.py: zhōu liù xià wǔ ba, dà jiā zhōu mò bǐ jiào yǒu jīng shén. dì diǎn jiù zài tú shū guǎn de sān lóu tǎo lùn shì, ān jìng yòu yǒu bái bǎn.
dialogue.en: Saturday afternoon. Everyone has more energy on the weekend. The location will be the discussion room on the third floor of the library; it's quiet and has a whiteboard.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 地點沒問題。但是圖書館的討論室需要提前預約，誰負責預約呢？
dialogue.py: dì diǎn méi wèn tí. dàn shì tú shū guǎn de tǎo lùn shì xū yào tí qián yù yuē, shuí fù zé yù yuē ne?
dialogue.en: Location is no problem. But the library's discussion room needs to be reserved in advance; who is responsible for booking?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我來負責吧。我每週三會在網上把房間訂好。
dialogue.py: wǒ lái fù zé ba. wǒ měi zhōu sān huì zài wǎng shàng bǎ fáng jiān dìng hǎo.
dialogue.en: I'll be responsible. I will book the room online every Wednesday.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 太好了。另外，為了保證效率，我們必須定幾條規則。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le. lìng wài, wèi le bǎo zhèng xiào lǜ, wǒ men bì xū dìng jǐ tiáo guī zé.
dialogue.en: Great. Besides, in order to guarantee efficiency, we must set a few rules.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 什麼規則？
dialogue.py: shén me guī zé?
dialogue.en: What rules?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 第一，不能遲到。第二，討論期間不能滑手機。第三，每個人都要輪流分享筆記。
dialogue.py: dì yī, bù néng chí dào. dì èr, tǎo lùn qī jiān bù néng huá shǒu jī. dì sān, měi gè rén dōu yào lún liú fēn xiǎng bǐ jì.
dialogue.en: First, no being late. Second, no swiping on phones during the discussion. Third, everyone must take turns sharing notes.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 不滑手機這點很重要，不然很容易分心。我完全同意。
dialogue.py: bù huá shǒu jī zhè diǎn hěn zhòng yào, bù rán hěn róng yì fēn xīn. wǒ wán quán tóng yì.
dialogue.en: Not swiping on phones is very important, otherwise it's easy to get distracted. I completely agree.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 輪流分享筆記也是個好主意。這週六我們就先從第一章和第二章開始吧。
dialogue.py: lún liú fēn xiǎng bǐ jì yě shì gè hǎo zhǔ yì. zhè zhōu liù wǒ men jiù xiān cóng dì yī zhāng hé dì èr zhāng kāi shǐ ba.
dialogue.en: Taking turns sharing notes is also a good idea. This Saturday we'll start with Chapter 1 and Chapter 2.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我會把這兩章的重點整理出來。大家週六見！
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí, wǒ huì bǎ zhè liǎng zhāng de zhòng diǎn zhěng lǐ chū lái. dà jiā zhōu liù jiàn!
dialogue.en: No problem, I will organize the key points of these two chapters. See you all on Saturday!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 週六見！希望能考個好成績。
dialogue.py: zhōu liù jiàn! xī wàng néng kǎo gè hǎo chéng jì.
dialogue.en: See you Saturday! Hope to get a good grade.

passage.title: Study Group Plan Listening Passage
passage.zh: 經濟學的期中考試快到了。馬克、大衛和莉莉覺得一個人讀書效率不高。他們決定組成一個讀書小組。他們在圖書館的討論室開會。他們需要定下每週聚會的時間和一些基本規則。
passage.en: Since everyone agrees to form a study group, let's set a specific plan. Okay. I think we need to meet at least twice a week; this way we can finish reviewing all the progress. Twice a week? I have to work part-time from Monday to Wednesday; I might not be able to cooperate. How about once a week, three hours each time? Once a week is also fine. Then should we set it for Thursday night, or Saturday afternoon? Saturday afternoon. Everyone has more energy on the weekend. The location will be the discussion room on the third floor of the library; it's quiet and has a whiteboard. Location is no problem. But the library's discussion room needs to be reserved in advance; who is responsible for booking? I'll be responsible. I will book the room online every Wednesday.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字，為你和朋友的任何一個社團或學習小組制定 3 條規則。說明為什麼這些規則很重要（例如：為了提高效率、保證公平）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '為了...' 表達目的。'輪流 + 動詞' 表示按順序交替做某事。'沒辦法配合' 用於委婉拒絕時間安排。

我們輪流做飯。 (We take turns cooking.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 兩千塊包不包含住宿和交通？
expansion_dialogue.py: liǎng qiān kuài bāo bù bāo hán zhù sù hé jiāo tōng?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.py: bāo hán. zhù sù wǒ men xuǎn qīng nián lǚ guǎn, zhè yàng kě yǐ shěng xià bù shǎo qián.
expansion_dialogue.en: It includes it. For accommodation, we will choose a youth hostel; this way we can save quite a bit of money.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 同意。為了避免麻煩，我建議大家先把錢交給負責人統一管理。
expansion_dialogue.py: tóng yì. wèi le bì miǎn má fan, wǒ jiàn yì dà jiā xiān bǎ qián jiāo gěi fù zé rén tǒng yī guǎn lǐ.

title: Preparing for an Exam
story_description: 期末考即將到來。馬克和大衛在圖書館討論各自的複習方法，並分享了應對壓力的策略。
story_intro: 下週就是期末考週了。
圖書館裡坐滿了正在熬夜讀書的學生。
馬克看著厚厚的課本，感到有點焦慮。
大衛看起來卻很輕鬆。
他們開始交流彼此的讀書方法。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，你複習得怎麼樣了？我看你這兩天都不怎麼緊張。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ fù xí de zěn me yàng le? wǒ kàn nǐ zhè liǎng tiān dōu bù zěn me jǐn zhāng.
dialogue.en: David, how is your reviewing going? I see you haven't been very nervous these two days.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我已經把重點都整理成心智圖了，現在只是在做最後的複習。
dialogue.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ zhòng diǎn dōu zhěng lǐ chéng xīn zhì tú le, xiàn zài zhǐ shì zài zuò zuì hòu de fù xí.
dialogue.en: I've already organized all the key points into mind maps; now I'm just doing the final review.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 心智圖？那是什麼？
dialogue.py: xīn zhì tú? nà shì shén me?
dialogue.en: Mind maps? What's that?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 就是一種筆記方法。把中心思想寫在中間，然後畫出分支，把相關的概念連起來。這樣記憶比較深刻。
dialogue.py: jiù shì yī zhǒng bǐ jì fāng fǎ. bǎ zhōng xīn sī xiǎng xiě zài zhōng jiān, rán hòu huà chū fēn zhī, bǎ xiāng guān de gài niàn lián qǐ lái. zhè yàng jì yì bǐ jiào shēn kè.
dialogue.en: It's a kind of note-taking method. Write the central idea in the middle, then draw branches, and connect related concepts. Remembering it this way is more profound.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很科學。我只是把課本從頭到尾看一遍，但看完就忘了大半。
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái hěn kē xué. wǒ zhǐ shì bǎ kè běn cóng tóu dào wěi kàn yī biàn, dàn kàn wán jiù wàng le dà bàn.
dialogue.en: Sounds very scientific. I just read the textbook from beginning to end once, but forgot most of it after reading.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 死記硬背是沒有用的。你應該試著用自己的話把內容解釋出來。
dialogue.py: sǐ jì yìng bèi shì méi yǒu yòng de. nǐ yīng gāi shì zhe yòng zì jǐ de huà bǎ nèi róng jiě shì chū lái.
dialogue.en: Rote memorization is useless. You should try to explain the content using your own words.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有道理。可是這次考試的範圍太廣了，我怕時間不夠。
dialogue.py: yǒu dào lǐ. kě shì zhè cì kǎo shì de fán wéi tài guǎng le, wǒ pà shí jiān bù gòu.
dialogue.en: Makes sense. But the scope of this exam is too broad; I'm afraid there's not enough time.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 別慌。你可以先挑歷年考題來做，找出自己最不熟悉的單元，集中火力複習。
dialogue.py: bié huāng. nǐ kě yǐ xiān tiāo lì nián kǎo tí lái zuò, zhǎo chū zì jǐ zuì bù shú xī de dān yuán, jí zhōng huǒ lì fù xí.
dialogue.en: Don't panic. You can first pick past years' exam questions to do, find out the units you are most unfamiliar with, and concentrate your firepower to review them.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 做歷年考題確實是個好方法。我今晚回去就試試看。
dialogue.py: zuò lì nián kǎo tí què shí shì gè hǎo fāng fǎ. wǒ jīn wǎn huí qù jiù shì shi kàn.
dialogue.en: Doing past years' exam questions is indeed a good method. I will try it when I go back tonight.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 而且，千萬不要熬夜。睡眠不足會影響大腦的運作。考前一天晚上一定要睡飽。
dialogue.py: ér qiě, qiān wàn bù yào áo yè. shuì mián bù zú huì yǐng xiǎng dà nǎo de yùn zuò. kǎo qián yī tiān wǎn shang yī dìng yào shuì bǎo.
dialogue.en: Also, absolutely do not stay up late. Lack of sleep will affect the brain's operation. You must sleep enough the night before the exam.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我知道，但我一焦慮就睡不著。
dialogue.py: wǒ zhī dào, dàn wǒ yī jiāo lǜ jiù shuì bù zháo.
dialogue.en: I know, but as soon as I'm anxious, I can't sleep.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 睡前可以聽點輕音樂，或者喝杯熱牛奶放鬆一下。相信自己，你平時上課很認真，一定沒問題的。
dialogue.py: shuì qián kě yǐ tīng diǎn qīng yīn yuè, huò zhě hē bēi rè niú nǎi fàng sōng yī xià. xiāng xìn zì jǐ, nǐ píng shí shàng kè hěn rèn zhēn, yī dìng méi wèn tí de.
dialogue.en: Before bed, you can listen to some light music, or drink a cup of hot milk to relax a bit. Believe in yourself; you are very serious in class normally, there will definitely be no problem.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，大衛。跟你聊完後，我覺得心裡踏實多了。
dialogue.py: xiè xie nǐ, dà wèi. gēn nǐ liáo wán hòu, wǒ jué de xīn lǐ tā shi duō le.
dialogue.en: Thank you, David. After chatting with you, I feel much more grounded/relieved inside.

passage.zh: 下週就是期末考週了。圖書館裡坐滿了正在熬夜讀書的學生。馬克看著厚厚的課本，感到有點焦慮。大衛看起來卻很輕鬆。他們開始交流彼此的讀書方法。

Sounds very scientific. I just read the textbook from beginning to end once, but forgot most of it after reading. Rote memorization is useless. writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字，分享你的一項有效學習策略。你是如何做筆記的？在考試前你會如何安排時間？這對你的學習有什麼幫助？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '從...到...' 表示起點和終點 (從頭到尾)。'一...就...' 表達條件觸發的結果 (一焦慮就睡不著)。'把...整理成...' 表示變化的結果。
examples: 從早到晚都在下雨。 (It rained from morning to night.)
他一緊張就結巴。 (As soon as he gets nervous, he stutters.)
把筆記整理成表格。 (Organize notes into a table.)
死記硬背 (Rote memorize)
影響運作 (Affect operation)

practice.q: Translate: Read from beginning to end.
Complete: 我___喝咖啡___睡不著。 (As soon as I drink... I can't sleep.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 下週要考口說，我發音一直不好，怎麼辦？
expansion_dialogue.py: xià zhōu yào kǎo kǒu shuō, wǒ fā yīn yī zhí bù hǎo, zěn me bàn?
expansion_dialogue.en: Next week is the speaking test, my pronunciation has always been bad, what should I do?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你可以試著把自己的聲音錄下來，然後跟母語人士的錄音做對比。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ kě yǐ shì zhe bǎ zì jǐ de shēng yīn lù xià lái, rán hòu gēn mǔ yǔ rén shì de lù yīn zuò duì bǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: You can try recording your own voice, and then compare it with a native speaker's recording.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對比之後呢？
expansion_dialogue.py: duì bǐ zhī hòu ne?
expansion_dialogue.en: After comparing?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 找出發音不準的地方，反覆模仿和練習。肌肉是有記憶的，練久了自然就順了。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhǎo chū fā yīn bù zhǔn de dì fang, fǎn fù mó fǎng hé liàn xí. jī ròu shì yǒu jì yì de, liàn jiǔ le zì rán jiù shùn le.
expansion_dialogue.en: Find out the inaccurately pronounced places, repeatedly imitate and practice. Muscles have memory; after practicing for a long time, it will naturally become smooth.

review.speaking: Explain a study method (like mind maps or past papers) to a friend in Chinese.
review.writing: Write a 70-word paragraph outlining an exam preparation plan.

title: After a Bad Test Result
story_description: 馬克的數學期中考成績很不理想，他感到非常沮喪。朋友安慰他並幫他分析原因。
story_intro: 期中考的成績公佈了。
馬克看著自己的數學考卷，嘆了一口氣。
他考得比預期的差很多。
他覺得自己明明很努力，卻沒有得到好結果。
他的朋友莉莉看到他很難過，走過來安慰他。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你怎麼了？看起來心情不太好。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ zěn me le? kàn qǐ lái xīn qíng bù tài hǎo.
dialogue.en: Mark, what's wrong? You look like you're not in a good mood.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我的數學期中考只考了六十分。剛好及格。
dialogue.py: wǒ de shù xué qī zhōng kǎo zhǐ kǎo le liù shí fēn. gāng hǎo jí gé.
dialogue.en: My math midterm exam only got sixty points. Just barely passed.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 啊，這的確有點低。你不是考前週末都在圖書館複習嗎？
dialogue.py: ā, zhè dí què yǒu diǎn dī. nǐ bú shì kǎo qián zhōu mò dōu zài tú shū guǎn fù xí ma?
dialogue.en: Ah, that is indeed a bit low. Weren't you reviewing in the library all weekend before the test?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對啊，我很努力地背了所有的公式，但考試的時候腦袋卻一片空白。我覺得我很笨。
dialogue.py: duì a, wǒ hěn nǔ lì de bèi le suǒ yǒu de gōng shì, dàn kǎo shì de shí hou nǎo dài què yī piàn kòng bái. wǒ jué de wǒ hěn bèn.
dialogue.en: Yeah, I tried very hard to memorize all the formulas, but during the exam my mind went completely blank. I feel I am very stupid.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 別這麼說，你不笨。可能只是你的讀書方法不對。數學不能只靠背公式。
dialogue.py: bié zhè me shuō, nǐ bù bèn. kě néng zhǐ shì nǐ de dú shū fāng fǎ bù duì. shù xué bù néng zhǐ kào bèi gōng shì.
dialogue.en: Don't say that, you are not stupid. Maybe it's just that your study method is wrong. Math can't rely solely on memorizing formulas.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那該怎麼辦？我對後面的課程完全沒有信心了。
dialogue.py: nà gāi zěn me bàn? wǒ duì hòu mian de kè chéng wán quán méi yǒu xìn xīn le.
dialogue.en: Then what should I do? I have absolutely no confidence in the subsequent courses now.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 一次考試不能代表一切。我們來看看你的錯題吧。是計算錯誤，還是看不懂題目？
dialogue.py: yī cì kǎo shì bù néng dài biǎo yī qiè. wǒ men lái kàn kan nǐ de cuò tí ba. shì jì suàn cuò wù, hái shì kàn bù dǒng tí mù?
dialogue.en: One exam cannot represent everything. Let's look at your incorrect questions. Was it calculation errors, or you couldn't understand the questions?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （翻開考卷）這幾題是因為粗心算錯了。但最後兩道大題，我根本不知道要用哪個公式。
dialogue.py: (fān kāi kǎo juàn) zhè jǐ tí shì yīn wèi cū xīn suàn cuò le. dàn zuì hòu liǎng dào dà tí, wǒ gēn běn bù zhī dào yào yòng nǎ ge gōng shì.
dialogue.en: (Opens test paper) These few questions were calculated wrong due to carelessness. But for the last two big questions, I simply didn't know which formula to use.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 這說明你不夠理解公式背後的邏輯。你必須多做不同類型的練習題，學會靈活運用。
dialogue.py: zhè shuō míng nǐ bù gòu lǐ jiě gōng shì bèi hòu de luó ji. nǐ bì xū duō zuò bù tóng lèi xíng de liàn xí tí, xué huì líng huó yùn yòng.
dialogue.en: This shows you don't sufficiently understand the logic behind the formulas. You must do more of different types of practice questions to learn to apply them flexibly.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你說得對。我平時太少做練習了，總是以為看懂了就會了。
dialogue.py: nǐ shuō de duì. wǒ píng shí tài shǎo zuò liàn xí le, zǒng shì yǐ wéi kàn dǒng le jiù huì le.
dialogue.en: You are right. I do too few practice questions normally, always assuming that understanding it by reading means I can do it.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，現在發現問題還來得及。我們以後每週挑兩個晚上一起算數學，有不懂的馬上討論。
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, xiàn zài fā xiàn wèn tí hái lái de jí. wǒ men yǐ hòu měi zhōu tiāo liǎng gè wǎn shang yī qǐ suàn shù xué, yǒu bù dǒng de mǎ shàng tǎo lùn.
dialogue.en: It's okay, finding the problem now is still in time. In the future, we'll pick two nights a week to do math together; if there's anything not understood, discuss it immediately.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太感謝你了，莉莉！有你幫忙，我一定能在期末考把分數拉上來。
dialogue.py: tài gǎn xiè nǐ le, lì lì! yǒu nǐ bāng máng, wǒ yī dìng néng zài qī mò kǎo bǎ fēn shù lā shàng lái.
dialogue.en: Thank you so much, Lily! With your help, I can definitely pull my score up in the final exam.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 加油！失敗是成功之母。我們一起努力！
dialogue.py: jiā yóu! shī bài shì chéng gōng zhī mǔ. wǒ men yī qǐ nǔ lì!
dialogue.en: Go for it! Failure is the mother of success. Let's work hard together!

key_sentences.zh: 一次考試不能代表一切。
我不夠理解背後的邏輯。
key_sentences.en: I don't sufficiently understand the logic behind it.

key_sentences.zh: 現在發現問題還來得及。
key_sentences.en: Finding the problem now is still in time.
Failure is the mother of success.
key_sentences.example: 俗話說，失敗是成功之母。

passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字的反思日記：回憶一次你失敗或考得不好的經驗。當時你的心情如何？後來你分析出了什麼原因？你學到了什麼教訓？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '根本不/沒' 表達完全否定 (根本不知道)。'來得及' 和 '來不及' 表達時間是否充足。'明明...卻...' 表達事實與結果的轉折與不如意。

快點走，不然會來不及。 (Walk faster, otherwise we won't be in time.)
他明明知道，卻不告訴我。 (He obviously knew, yet he didn't tell me.)
一片空白 (Completely blank)
粗心算錯 (Calculate wrong due to carelessness)

practice.q: Complete: 我___很努力了，卻沒有考好。 (Obviously did... yet...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這次的駕照考試我又沒過，我真的想放棄了。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè cì de jià zhào kǎo shì wǒ yòu méi guò, wǒ zhēn de xiǎng fàng qì le.
expansion_dialogue.en: I failed the driver's license test again this time, I really want to give up.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 別灰心。你是路考沒過還是筆試沒過？
expansion_dialogue.py: bié huī xīn. nǐ shì lù kǎo méi guò hái shì bǐ shì méi guò?
expansion_dialogue.en: Don't lose heart. Did you fail the road test or the written test?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 路考。我一上車就緊張，停車的時候撞到了旁邊的桿子。
expansion_dialogue.py: lù kǎo. wǒ yī shàng chē jiù jǐn zhāng, tíng chē de shí hou zhuàng dào le páng biān de gān zi.
expansion_dialogue.en: Road test. As soon as I get in the car I get nervous; when parking I hit the pole next to me.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這是心理素質的問題。下次考前深呼吸，慢慢來。很多人都是考了三四次才過的。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè shì xīn lǐ sù zhì de wèn tí. xià cì kǎo qián shēn hū xī, màn màn lái. hěn duō rén dōu shì kǎo le sān sì cì cái guò de.
expansion_dialogue.en: This is a problem of psychological quality. Next time before the test, take a deep breath, take it slow. Many people only pass after taking it three or four times.

title: Learning a New Language
story_description: 馬克在中文課上與同學討論學習新語言的動機、目標以及遇到的困難。
story_intro: 今天是中文口語課。
老師讓大家分組討論學習中文的原因。
馬克和他的同學安娜分在同一組。
他們分享了各自的目標和學習中遇到的困難。
他們發現雖然動機不同，但都覺得中文很有趣。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你當初為什麼選擇學中文？是因為工作需要嗎？
dialogue.py: ān nà, nǐ dāng chū wèi shén me xuǎn zé xué zhōng wén? shì yīn wèi gōng zuò xū yào ma?
dialogue.en: Anna, why did you choose to learn Chinese in the first place? Is it because of work needs?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 其實不是。我對中國歷史和文化非常著迷，特別是書法和茶道。學中文是為了更好地了解這些。
dialogue.py: qí shí bù shì. wǒ duì zhōng guó lì shǐ hé wén huà fēi cháng zháo mí, tè bié shì shū fǎ hé chá dào. xué zhōng wén shì wèi le gèng hǎo de liǎo jiě zhè xiē.
dialogue.en: Actually no. I am very fascinated by Chinese history and culture, especially calligraphy and tea ceremony. Learning Chinese is to better understand these.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 原來如此。我是因為將來想去亞洲從事金融工作，會說中文會給我帶來很大的優勢。
dialogue.py: yuán lái rú cǐ. wǒ shì yīn wèi jiāng lái xiǎng qù yà zhōu cóng shì jīn róng gōng zuò, huì shuō zhōng wén huì gěi wǒ dài lái hěn dà de yōu shì.
dialogue.en: I see. It's because I want to go to Asia to engage in financial work in the future; being able to speak Chinese will bring me a big advantage.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 你的目標很明確。那你覺得學中文最困難的部分是什麼？
dialogue.py: nǐ de mù biāo hěn míng què. nà nǐ jué de xué zhōng wén zuì kùn nán de bù fèn shì shén me?
dialogue.en: Your goal is very clear. Then what do you think is the most difficult part of learning Chinese?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對我來說，最難的是聲調。有時候聲調一錯，意思就完全不同了。鬧過不少笑話。
dialogue.py: duì wǒ lái shuō, zuì nán de shì shēng diào. yǒu shí hou shēng diào yī cuò, yì si jiù wán quán bù tóng le. nào guò bù shǎo xiào hua.
dialogue.en: For me, the hardest is the tones. Sometimes once the tone is wrong, the meaning is completely different. Made quite a few jokes (embarrassed myself).

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 我完全同意！不過我覺得寫漢字比發音更讓人頭疼。筆畫太多了，很容易忘記怎麼寫。
dialogue.py: wǒ wán quán tóng yì! bù guò wǒ jué de xiě hàn zì bǐ fā yīn gèng ràng rén tóu téng. bǐ huà tài duō le, hěn róng yì wàng jì zěn me xiě.
dialogue.en: I completely agree! But I think writing Chinese characters makes one's head ache even more than pronunciation. There are too many strokes, very easy to forget how to write.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 的確如此。為了解決這個問題，我每天堅持寫日記。雖然句子很簡單，但對記單字很有幫助。
dialogue.py: dí què rú cǐ. wèi le jiě jué zhè ge wèn tí, wǒ měi tiān jiān chí xiě rì jì. suī rán jù zi hěn jiǎn dān, dàn duì jì dān zì hěn yǒu bāng zhù.
dialogue.en: Indeed. To solve this problem, I persist in writing a diary every day. Although the sentences are very simple, it's very helpful for remembering vocabulary.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 這真是個好方法。我的短期目標是能看懂沒有拼音的中文報紙。你呢？
dialogue.py: zhè zhēn shì gè hǎo fāng fǎ. wǒ de duǎn qī mù biāo shì néng kàn dǒng méi yǒu pīn yīn de zhōng wén bào zhǐ. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: This is really a good method. My short-term goal is to be able to read Chinese newspapers without Pinyin. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我的短期目標是通過明年的 TOCFL 考試。長期目標是能流利地和當地客戶開會。
dialogue.py: wǒ de duǎn qī mù biāo shì tōng guò míng tiān de TOCFL kǎo shì. cháng qī mù biāo shì néng liú lì de hé dāng dì kè hù kāi huì.
dialogue.en: My short-term goal is to pass the TOCFL exam next year. Long-term goal is to be able to fluently hold meetings with local clients.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 哇，那需要很專業的商業詞彙。看來你還要下很大的功夫。
dialogue.py: wa, nà xū yào hěn zhuān yè de shāng yè cí huì. kàn lái nǐ hái yào xià hěn dà de gōng fu.
dialogue.en: Wow, that requires very professional business vocabulary. Looks like you still have to put in a lot of effort.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 是啊，語言學習是一條漫長的路。不過只要我們不放棄，總有一天能達到目標。
dialogue.py: shì a, yǔ yán xué xí shì yī tiáo màn cháng de lù. bù guò zhǐ yào wǒ men bù fàng qì, zǒng yǒu yī tiān néng dá dào mù biāo.
dialogue.en: Yeah, language learning is a long road. But as long as we don't give up, there will always be a day we can reach our goal.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 說得對！為了我們的目標，一起加油吧！
dialogue.py: shuō de duì! wèi le wǒ men de mù biāo, yī qǐ jiā yóu ba!
dialogue.en: Well said! For our goals, let's go for it together!

key_sentences.zh: 對歷史和文化非常著迷。
key_sentences.en: Very fascinated by history and culture.

key_sentences.zh: 會給我帶來很大的優勢。
key_sentences.en: Will bring me a big advantage.

key_sentences.zh: 聲調一錯，意思就完全不同了。
key_sentences.en: Once the tone is wrong, the meaning is completely different.
Made quite a few jokes (embarrassed oneself).
Makes one's head ache even more than pronunciation.
I persist in writing a diary every day.
Still need to put in a lot of effort.

passage.title: Learning a New Language Listening Passage
passage.zh: 今天是中文口語課。老師讓大家分組討論學習中文的原因。馬克和他的同學安娜分在同一組。他們分享了各自的目標和學習中遇到的困難。他們發現雖然動機不同，但都覺得中文很有趣。
passage.en: Anna, why did you choose to learn Chinese in the first place? Is it because of work needs? Actually no. I am very fascinated by Chinese history and culture, especially calligraphy and tea ceremony. Learning Chinese is to better understand these. I see. It's because I want to go to Asia to engage in financial work in the future; being able to speak Chinese will bring me a big advantage. Your goal is very clear. Then what do you think is the most difficult part of learning Chinese? For me, the hardest is the tones. Sometimes once the tone is wrong, the meaning is completely different. Made quite a few jokes (embarrassed myself). I completely agree! But I think writing Chinese characters makes one's head ache even more than pronunciation. There are too many strokes, very easy to forget how to write. Indeed. To solve this problem, I persist in writing a diary every day. Although the sentences are very simple, it's very helpful for remembering vocabulary.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字，敘述你學習目前這個語言的動機（當初為什麼學？）、遇到的一個困難（例如發音或文法），以及你的解決方法。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '對...著迷' 表達強烈的興趣。'比...更讓人...' 用於比較句中強烈的情緒 (寫字比發音更讓人頭疼)。'只要...總有一天能...' 表達條件與最終希望。
examples: 他對這本小說非常著迷。 (He is very fascinated by this novel.)
數學比歷史更讓人頭疼。 (Math makes one's head ache even more than history.)
只要努力，總有一天會成功。 (As long as you try hard, there will always be a day you succeed.)
帶來優勢 (Bring an advantage)
下功夫 (Put in effort)

practice.q: Translate: Make a joke/fool of oneself.
Translate: Put in a lot of effort.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你學吉他學了多久了？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ xué jí ta xué le duō jiǔ le?
expansion_dialogue.en: How long have you been learning to play the guitar?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 剛滿三個月。可是我的手指按弦按得很痛，感覺進步很慢。
expansion_dialogue.py: gāng mǎn sān gè yuè. kě shì wǒ de shǒu zhǐ àn xián àn de hěn tòng, gǎn jué jìn bù hěn màn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Just hit three months. But my fingers hurt a lot from pressing the strings; I feel progress is very slow.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 萬事起頭難。度過了最初的瓶頸期，後面就會越來越順利。
expansion_dialogue.py: wàn shì qǐ tóu nán. dù guò le zuì chū de píng jǐng qī, hòu mian jiù huì yuè lái yuè shùn lì.
expansion_dialogue.en: Everything is hard in the beginning. Once you get through the initial bottleneck period, it will get smoother and smoother later.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 希望如此。我的短期目標是能完整地彈唱一首歌。
expansion_dialogue.py: xī wàng rú cǐ. wǒ de duǎn qī mù biāo shì néng wán zhěng de tán chàng yī shǒu gē.
expansion_dialogue.en: Hope so. My short-term goal is to be able to completely play and sing one song.

review.speaking: Explain your short-term and long-term language learning goals.
review.writing: Write a 70-word goal statement detailing your language learning motivation.
review.self_check: 你能用中文談論學習動機、描述困難並區分短期和長期目標嗎？

title: Finding a Language Partner
story_description: 馬克在網上發布了尋找語言交換夥伴的訊息。他收到了一位台灣學生的回覆，並安排了第一次會面。
story_intro: 為了提高口語能力，馬克想找一位語言交換夥伴。
他在學校的佈告欄和論壇上留了訊息。
一位名叫陳宇的台灣學生加了他的通訊軟體。
陳宇想練習英文，馬克想練習中文。
他們互相自我介紹並約定時間見面。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好！你是陳宇對吧？我是在學校論壇上發布語言交換訊息的馬克。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo! nǐ shì chén yǔ duì ba? wǒ shì zài xué xiào lùn tán shàng fā bù yǔ yán jiāo huàn xùn xí de mǎ kè.
dialogue.en: Hello! You are Chen Yu right? I am Mark, who posted the language exchange message on the school forum.

dialogue.speaker: Chen Yu
dialogue.zh: 你好馬克，很高興認識你。我看你的貼文說，你想練習中文口語？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo mǎ kè, hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ. wǒ kàn nǐ de tiē wén shuō, nǐ xiǎng liàn xí zhōng wén kǒu yǔ?
dialogue.en: Hello Mark, nice to meet you. I saw your post said you want to practice Chinese speaking?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，我來這裡半年了，聽力和閱讀進步很快，但口語還是不太流利。我想找人每週練習對話。
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ lái zhè lǐ bàn nián le, tīng lì hé yuè dú jìn bù hěn kuài, dàn kǒu yǔ hái shì bù tài liú lì. wǒ xiǎng zhǎo rén měi zhōu liàn xí duì huà.
dialogue.en: Yes, I've been here for half a year; listening and reading have improved quickly, but speaking is still not very fluent. I want to find someone to practice conversation with every week.

dialogue.speaker: Chen Yu
dialogue.zh: 剛好相反，我的英文讀寫沒問題，但是跟外國人講話就容易卡住。我們正好可以互補！
dialogue.py: gāng hǎo xiāng fǎn, wǒ de yīng wén dú xiě méi wèn tí, dàn shì gēn wài guó rén jiǎng huà jiù róng yì kǎ zhù. wǒ men zhèng hǎo kě yǐ hù bǔ!
dialogue.en: Exactly the opposite, my English reading and writing have no problem, but when talking to foreigners I easily get stuck. We can just complement each other!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。你平時哪天比較有空？我們可以在咖啡廳或者圖書館見面。
dialogue.py: tài bàng le. nǐ píng shí nǎ tiān bǐ jiào yǒu kòng? wǒ men kě yǐ zài kā fēi tīng huò zhě tú shū guǎn jiàn miàn.
dialogue.en: Awesome. Which day are you usually free? We can meet at a coffee shop or the library.

dialogue.speaker: Chen Yu
dialogue.zh: 我週二和週五下午都沒有課。每次我們練習一個小時，半小時英文，半小時中文，你覺得怎麼樣？
dialogue.py: wǒ zhōu èr hé zhōu wǔ xià wǔ dōu méi yǒu kè. měi cì wǒ men liàn xí yī gè xiǎo shí, bàn xiǎo shí yīng wén, bàn xiǎo shí zhōng wén, nǐ jué de zěn me yàng?
dialogue.en: I have no classes on Tuesday and Friday afternoons. Each time we practice for an hour, half an hour English, half an hour Chinese, what do you think?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這個安排很公平。那就定在週二下午三點，在學校南門旁邊的星巴克吧。
dialogue.py: zhè ge ān pái hěn gōng píng. nà jiù dìng zài zhōu èr xià wǔ sān diǎn, zài xué xiào nán mén páng biān de xīng bā kè ba.
dialogue.en: This arrangement is very fair. Then let's set it for Tuesday afternoon at three, at the Starbucks next to the school's south gate.

dialogue.speaker: Chen Yu
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。第一次見面，我們需要準備什麼特別的話題嗎？
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. dì yī cì jiàn miàn, wǒ men xū yào zhǔn bèi shén me tè bié de huà tí ma?
dialogue.en: No problem. For the first meeting, do we need to prepare any special topics?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 第一次就輕鬆一點吧，聊聊各自的家鄉、愛好，還有為什麼學語言。
dialogue.py: dì yī cì jiù qīng sōng yī diǎn ba, liáo liao gè zì de jiā xiāng, ài hào, hái yǒu wèi shén me xué yǔ yán.
dialogue.en: Let's keep it relaxed the first time; chat about our respective hometowns, hobbies, and why we are learning languages.

dialogue.speaker: Chen Yu
dialogue.zh: 好主意。順便問一下，你有什麼特別想加強的中文主題嗎？比如點餐、還是旅遊？
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì. shùn biàn wèn yī xià, nǐ yǒu shén me tè bié xiǎng jiā qiáng de zhōng wén zhǔ tí ma? bǐ rú diǎn cān, hái shì lǚ yóu?
dialogue.en: Good idea. By the way, do you have any Chinese topics you particularly want to strengthen? For example ordering food, or traveling?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想加強日常交流，比如怎麼禮貌地拒絕別人，或者表達不同的意見。有時候我怕說話太直接會沒禮貌。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng jiā qiáng rì cháng jiāo liú, bǐ rú zěn me lǐ mào de jù jué bié rén, huò zhě biǎo dá bù tóng de yì jiàn. yǒu shí hou wǒ pà shuō huà tài zhí jiē huì méi lǐ mào.
dialogue.en: I want to strengthen daily communication, such as how to politely reject someone, or express different opinions. Sometimes I'm afraid being too direct is impolite.

dialogue.speaker: Chen Yu
dialogue.zh: 懂了，這也是很多外國人會遇到 的問題。別擔心，我會慢慢教你的。期待週二見面！
dialogue.py: dǒng le, zhè yě shì hěn duō wài guó rén huì yù dào de wèn tí. bié dān xīn, wǒ huì màn màn jiāo nǐ de. qī dài zhōu èr jiàn miàn!
dialogue.en: Understood, this is also a problem many foreigners encounter. Don't worry, I will teach you slowly. Looking forward to meeting on Tuesday!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，週二見！
dialogue.py: hǎo de, zhōu èr jiàn!
dialogue.en: Okay, see you Tuesday!

key_sentences.en: Listening and reading have improved quickly.

key_sentences.zh: 跟外國人講話就容易卡住。

passage.title: Finding a Language Partner Listening Passage
passage.zh: 為了提高口語能力，馬克想找一位語言交換夥伴。他在學校的佈告欄和論壇上留了訊息。一位名叫陳宇的台灣學生加了他的通訊軟體。陳宇想練習英文，馬克想練習中文。他們互相自我介紹並約定時間見面。
passage.en: Hello! You are Chen Yu right? I am Mark, who posted the language exchange message on the school forum. Hello Mark, nice to meet you. I saw your post said you want to practice Chinese speaking? Yes, I've been here for half a year; listening and reading have improved quickly, but speaking is still not very fluent. I want to find someone to practice conversation with every week. Exactly the opposite, my English reading and writing have no problem, but when talking to foreigners I easily get stuck. We can just complement each other! Awesome. Which day are you usually free? We can meet at a coffee shop or the library. I have no classes on Tuesday and Friday afternoons. Each time we practice for an hour, half an hour English, half an hour Chinese, what do you think? This arrangement is very fair. Then let's set it for Tuesday afternoon at three, at the Starbucks next to the school's south gate.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字的語言交換徵友訊息。介紹你的母語、正在學習的語言，你的興趣愛好，以及你希望如何安排練習時間。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '剛好相反' 表示對立情況。'順便問一下' 用於轉移話題或添加問題 (By the way)。'怕...會...' 表達擔憂 (怕說話太直接會沒禮貌)。
examples: 他喜歡吃辣，我剛好相反。 (He likes spicy food, I am exactly the opposite.)
順便買一份報紙。 (Buy a newspaper on the way/conveniently.)
順便問一下，廁所在哪裡？ (By the way, where is the restroom?)
我怕太晚會打擾他。 (I'm afraid being too late will disturb him.)
互相幫助，優勢互補。 (Help each other, complement each other's strengths.)

practice.q: Translate: By the way, what time is it?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我們下週的語言交換改到週三晚上可以嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ men xià zhōu de yǔ yán jiāo huàn gǎi dào zhōu sān wǎn shang kě yǐ ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Can we change our language exchange next week to Wednesday night?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 週三晚上我要加班，可能不行。週四下午呢？
expansion_dialogue.py: zhōu sān wǎn shang wǒ yào jiā bān, kě néng bù xíng. zhōu sì xià wǔ ne?
expansion_dialogue.en: I have to work overtime on Wednesday night, probably won't work. How about Thursday afternoon?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 週四下午可以。對了，上次你說想學一些流行用語，我整理了幾個詞給你。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhōu sì xià wǔ kě yǐ. duì le, shàng cì nǐ shuō xiǎng xué yī xiē liú xíng yòng yǔ, wǒ zhěng lǐ le jǐ gè cí gěi nǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Thursday afternoon is fine. By the way, last time you said you wanted to learn some slang, I organized a few words for you.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 太棒了，謝謝你！我很期待。
expansion_dialogue.py: tài bàng le, xiè xie nǐ! wǒ hěn qī dài.
expansion_dialogue.en: Awesome, thank you! I'm looking forward to it.

title: At the Gym
story_description: 馬克決定開始運動。他去附近的健身房詢問會員方案、設施以及私人教練的課程。
story_intro: 馬克最近覺得體力變差了。
他決定加入附近的健身房。
他下課後走到健身房的櫃檯。
他向工作人員詢問了收費標準。
他也了解了健身房的開放時間和課程。

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 你好！歡迎來到動力健身房。請問是來參觀的嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo! huān yíng lái dào dòng lì jiàn shēn fáng. qǐng wèn shì lái cān guān de ma?
dialogue.en: Hello! Welcome to Power Gym. Are you here for a tour?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想了解一下你們的會員方案。我以前沒有健身的習慣。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng liǎo jiě yī xià nǐ men de huì yuán fāng àn. wǒ yǐ qián méi yǒu jiàn shēn de xí guàn.
dialogue.en: Hello, I want to understand your membership plans. I haven't had the habit of working out before.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。我們有月卡、半年卡和年卡。如果你想長期運動，年卡最划算，平均一個月只要一千塊。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. wǒ men yǒu yuè kǎ, bàn nián kǎ hé nián kǎ. rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng cháng qī yùn dòng, nián kǎ zuì huá suàn, píng jūn yī gè yuè zhǐ yào yī qiān kuài.
dialogue.en: No problem. We have monthly passes, half-year passes, and yearly passes. If you want to exercise long-term, the yearly pass is the most cost-effective, averaging only one thousand dollars a month.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 一千塊不貴。那會員可以免費使用所有器材嗎？
dialogue.py: yī qiān kuài bù guì. nà huì yuán kě yǐ miǎn fèi shǐ yòng suǒ yǒu qì cái ma?
dialogue.en: One thousand dollars is not expensive. Then can members use all equipment for free?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 是的，一樓的跑步機、二樓的重訓器材都可以免費使用。而且我們每天都有免費的團體課程，像瑜珈和飛輪。
dialogue.py: shì de, yī lóu de pǎo bù jī, èr lóu de zhòng xùn qì cái dōu kě yǐ miǎn fèi shǐ yòng. ér qiě wǒ men měi tiān dōu yǒu miǎn fèi de tuán tǐ kè chéng, xiàng yú jiā hé fēi lún.
dialogue.en: Yes, the treadmills on the first floor and the weight training equipment on the second floor can all be used for free. And we have free group classes every day, like yoga and spinning.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很豐富。因為我是新手，怕自己使用器材會受傷。你們有私人教練嗎？
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái hěn fēng fù. yīn wèi wǒ shì xīn shǒu, pà zì jǐ shǐ yòng qì cái huì shòu shāng. nǐ men yǒu sī rén jiào liàn ma?
dialogue.en: Sounds very rich. Because I'm a novice, I'm afraid I'll get hurt using the equipment myself. Do you have personal trainers?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 有的。私人教練是一對一指導，費用是另外計算的。一堂課大約一千五百塊。教練會幫你設計專屬的訓練菜單。
dialogue.py: yǒu de. sī rén jiào liàn shì yī duì yī zhǐ dǎo, fèi yòng shì lìng wài jì suàn de. yī táng kè dà yuē yī qiān wǔ bǎi kuài. jiào liàn huì bāng nǐ shè jì zhuān shǔ de xùn liàn cài dān.
dialogue.en: Yes. Personal trainers provide one-on-one guidance; the fee is calculated separately. One class is about one thousand five hundred dollars. The trainer will help you design an exclusive training menu.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 一千五百塊有點超出我的預算。我先辦普通的年卡好了，先從跑步和團體課開始。
dialogue.py: yī qiān wǔ bǎi kuài yǒu diǎn chāo chū wǒ de yù suàn. wǒ xiān bàn pǔ tōng de nián kǎ hǎo le, xiān cóng pǎo bù hé tuán tǐ kè kāi shǐ.
dialogue.en: One thousand five hundred is a bit beyond my budget. I'll just get a regular yearly pass first, and start with running and group classes.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 好的。對了，如果是學生，憑學生證可以免收入會費喔！
dialogue.py: hǎo de. duì le, rú guǒ shì xué sheng, píng xué sheng zhèng kě yǐ miǎn shōu rù huì fèi ō!
dialogue.en: Okay. By the way, if you are a student, by presenting a student ID you can be exempted from the joining fee!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那太幸運了。這是我學生證。請問你們的營業時間是幾點到幾點？
dialogue.py: zhēn de ma? nà tài xìng yùn le. zhè shì wǒ xué sheng zhèng. qǐng wèn nǐ men de yíng yè shí jiān shì jǐ diǎn dào jǐ diǎn?
dialogue.en: Really? That's so lucky. Here is my student ID. May I ask what your business hours are?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 我們從早上六點營業到晚上十二點。你下課後來運動時間非常充裕。
dialogue.py: wǒ men cóng zǎo shang liù diǎn yíng yè dào wǎn shang shí èr diǎn. nǐ xià kè hòu lái yùn dòng shí jiān fēi cháng chōng yù.
dialogue.en: We operate from 6 AM to 12 midnight. The time for you to come exercise after class is very ample.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那麻煩幫我辦理年卡。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le. nà má fan bāng wǒ bàn lǐ nián kǎ.
dialogue.en: Great. Then please help me process the yearly pass.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，請在這裡填寫基本資料。辦好後會給你一張會員卡，進出刷卡就可以了。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí, qǐng zài zhè lǐ tián xiě jī běn zī liào. bàn hǎo hòu huì gěi nǐ yī zhāng huì yuán kǎ, jìn chū shuā kǎ jiù kě yǐ le.
dialogue.en: No problem, please fill in your basic info here. After it's done I'll give you a membership card; just swipe it to enter and exit.

key_sentences.en: The yearly pass is the most cost-effective.

key_sentences.zh: 怕自己使用器材會受傷。
key_sentences.en: Afraid of getting hurt using the equipment myself.

key_sentences.zh: 私人教練是一對一指導。
憑學生證可以免收入會費。
key_sentences.en: By presenting a student ID, the joining fee can be waived.

passage.title: At the Gym Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克最近覺得體力變差了。他決定加入附近的健身房。他下課後走到健身房的櫃檯。他向工作人員詢問了收費標準。他也了解了健身房的開放時間和課程。
passage.en: Hello! Welcome to Power Gym. Are you here for a tour? Hello, I want to understand your membership plans. I haven't had the habit of working out before. No problem. We have monthly passes, half-year passes, and yearly passes. If you want to exercise long-term, the yearly pass is the most cost-effective, averaging only one thousand dollars a month. One thousand dollars is not expensive. Then can members use all equipment for free? Yes, the treadmills on the first floor and the weight training equipment on the second floor can all be used for free. And we have free group classes every day, like yoga and spinning. Sounds very rich. Because I'm a novice, I'm afraid I'll get hurt using the equipment myself. Do you have personal trainers? Yes. Personal trainers provide one-on-one guidance; the fee is calculated separately. One class is about one thousand five hundred dollars. The trainer will help you design an exclusive training menu.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字，設定一個你自己的運動或健康目標。你打算每週運動幾次？你要做什麼運動？你希望能達到什麼效果？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '憑 (píng)' 表示依據或證明 (憑學生證)。'超出預算' 是常見的財務表達。'划算' 是形容詞，表示性價比高。
examples: 憑票入場。 (Admission by ticket.)
這頓飯吃得很划算。 (This meal was very cost-effective.)
買車超出了我的預算。 (Buying a car exceeded my budget.)
平均每天 (On average every day)
時間充裕 (Ample time)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 請問這台跑步機怎麼開？
expansion_dialogue.py: qǐng wèn zhè tái pǎo bù jī zěn me kāi?
expansion_dialogue.en: Excuse me, how do I turn on this treadmill?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你要先站上去，然後按下綠色的『Start』按鈕。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ yào xiān zhàn shàng qù, rán hòu àn xià lǜ sè de 'Start' àn niǔ.
expansion_dialogue.en: You need to step on it first, then press the green 'Start' button.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 按了。那怎麼調整速度和坡度？
expansion_dialogue.py: àn le. nà zěn me tiáo zhěng sù dù hé pō dù?
expansion_dialogue.en: Pressed it. Then how do I adjust the speed and incline?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 右邊的加減號是調速度，左邊是調坡度。記得要把安全夾夾在衣服上，以免摔倒。
expansion_dialogue.py: yòu biān de jiā jiǎn hào shì tiáo sù dù, zuǒ biān shì tiáo pō dù. jì de yào bǎ ān quán jiā jiā zài yī fu shàng, yǐ miǎn shuāi dǎo.
expansion_dialogue.en: The plus and minus signs on the right are for adjusting speed, left is for incline. Remember to clip the safety clip to your clothes, to avoid falling.

title: Healthy Habits
story_description: 馬克和莉莉在吃午餐時討論各自的生活習慣，包括睡眠、飲食和運動。
story_intro: 馬克最近覺得總是很累，精神不好。
中午在學生餐廳，他點了一份炸雞和可樂。
莉莉看到他的午餐，皺了皺眉頭。
他們開始討論什麼是健康的生活方式。
莉莉給了馬克一些改變習慣的建議。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你中午就吃炸雞和可樂嗎？難怪你最近看起來這麼累。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ zhōng wǔ jiù chī zhá jī hé kě lè ma? nán guài nǐ zuì jìn kàn qǐ lái zhè me lèi.
dialogue.en: Mark, you are just eating fried chicken and cola for lunch? No wonder you look so tired recently.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 因為炸雞很方便啊，而且很好吃。我最近確實常常覺得沒精神。
dialogue.py: yīn wèi zhá jī hěn fāng biàn a, ér qiě hěn hǎo chī. wǒ zuì jìn què shí cháng cháng jué de méi jīng shén.
dialogue.en: Because fried chicken is convenient, and very delicious. I have indeed frequently felt a lack of energy recently.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 這就是因為你的飲食太不均衡了。你應該多吃蔬菜和水果，少吃油炸的食物。
dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì yīn wèi nǐ de yǐn shí tài bù jūn héng le. nǐ yīng gāi duō chī shū cài hé shuǐ guǒ, shǎo chī yóu zhá de shí wù.
dialogue.en: This is because your diet is too unbalanced. You should eat more vegetables and fruits, and eat less deep-fried food.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我知道吃青菜很重要，但外食很難買到健康的食物。你平常都吃什麼？
dialogue.py: wǒ zhī dào chī qīng cài hěn zhòng yào, dàn wài shí hěn nán mǎi dào jiàn kāng de shí wù. nǐ píng cháng dōu chī shén me?
dialogue.en: I know eating greens is important, but eating out it's hard to buy healthy food. What do you usually eat?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 我每天晚上都會自己做便當，隔天帶到學校吃。像今天我帶了烤鮭魚、糙米飯和花椰菜。
dialogue.py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang dōu huì zì jǐ zuò biàn dāng, gé tiān dài dào xué xiào chī. xiàng jīn tiān wǒ dài le kǎo guī yú, cāo mǐ fàn hé huā yě cài.
dialogue.en: I make my own bento every night, and bring it to school to eat the next day. Like today I brought baked salmon, brown rice, and broccoli.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很健康。除了飲食，我的睡眠時間可能也不太夠。我每天大概只睡五個小時。
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái hěn jiàn kāng. chú le yǐn shí, wǒ de shuì mián shí jiān kě néng yě bù tài gòu. wǒ měi tiān dà gài zhǐ shuì wǔ gè xiǎo shí.
dialogue.en: Sounds very healthy. Besides diet, my sleep time is probably also not enough. I only sleep about five hours a day.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 五個小時太少了！成年人每天至少需要睡七到八個小時。你晚上都在做什麼？
dialogue.py: wǔ gè xiǎo shí tài shǎo le! chéng nián rén měi tiān zhì shǎo xū yào shuì qī dào bā gè xiǎo shí. nǐ wǎn shang dōu zài zuò shén me?
dialogue.en: Five hours is too little! Adults need to sleep at least seven to eight hours every day. What are you doing at night?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我習慣在睡前滑手機，看影片或者打遊戲，不知不覺就半夜兩點了。
dialogue.py: wǒ xí guàn zài shuì qián huá shǒu jī, kàn yǐng piàn huò zhě dǎ yóu xì, bù zhī bù jué jiù bàn yè liǎng diǎn le.
dialogue.en: I have a habit of swiping on my phone before bed, watching videos or playing games, and before I know it, it's 2 AM in the middle of the night.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 睡前看螢幕會影響睡眠品質。你應該嘗試在十一點前放下手機，看看書，讓大腦放鬆。
dialogue.py: shuì qián kàn yíng mù huì yǐng xiǎng shuì mián pǐn zhí. nǐ yīng gāi cháng shì zài shí yī diǎn qián fàng xià shǒu jī, kàn kan shū, ràng dà nǎo fàng sōng.
dialogue.en: Looking at screens before bed will affect sleep quality. You should try to put down your phone before 11 o'clock, read a book, and let your brain relax.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 改變習慣真的很難，但我不能再這樣下去了。我昨天剛報名了健身房，打算開始運動。
dialogue.py: gǎi biàn xí guàn zhēn de hěn nán, dàn wǒ bù néng zài zhè yàng xià qù le. wǒ zuó tiān gāng bào míng le jiàn shēn fáng, dǎ suàn kāi shǐ yùn dòng.
dialogue.en: Changing habits is really hard, but I can't go on like this anymore. I just signed up for the gym yesterday, planning to start exercising.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 這是個好開始！運動可以改善血液循環，也能幫助你晚上睡得更好。
dialogue.py: zhè shì gè hǎo kāi shǐ! yùn dòng kě yǐ gǎi shàn xiě yè xún huán, yě néng bāng zhù nǐ wǎn shang shuì de gèng hǎo.
dialogue.en: This is a good start! Exercising can improve blood circulation, and can also help you sleep better at night.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，我要戒掉宵夜，多喝水，早點睡覺。從今天晚上開始！
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ yào jiè diào xiāo yè, duō hē shuǐ, zǎo diǎn shuì jiào. cóng jīn tiān wǎn shang kāi shǐ!
dialogue.en: Yes, I want to quit late-night snacks, drink more water, and go to bed earlier. Starting from tonight!

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 我支持你。如果需要，我可以跟你分享一些簡單的健康食譜。
dialogue.py: wǒ zhī chí nǐ. rú guǒ xū yào, wǒ kě yǐ gēn nǐ fēn xiǎng yī xiē jiǎn dān de jiàn kāng shí pǔ.
dialogue.en: I support you. If needed, I can share some simple healthy recipes with you.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝謝你！
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, xiè xie nǐ!
dialogue.en: Great, thank you!

key_sentences.zh: 難怪你最近看起來這麼累。
key_sentences.en: No wonder you look so tired recently.

key_sentences.zh: 我每天晚上都會自己做便當。
key_sentences.en: I make my own bento every night.

key_sentences.zh: 不知不覺就半夜兩點了。
key_sentences.en: Before knowing it (unconsciously), it was 2 AM.
I can't go on like this anymore.
I want to quit late-night snacks.

passage.title: Healthy Habits Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克最近覺得總是很累，精神不好。中午在學生餐廳，他點了一份炸雞和可樂。莉莉看到他的午餐，皺了皺眉頭。他們開始討論什麼是健康的生活方式。莉莉給了馬克一些改變習慣的建議。
passage.en: Mark, you are just eating fried chicken and cola for lunch? No wonder you look so tired recently. Because fried chicken is convenient, and very delicious. I have indeed frequently felt a lack of energy recently. This is because your diet is too unbalanced. You should eat more vegetables and fruits, and eat less deep-fried food. I know eating greens is important, but eating out it's hard to buy healthy food. What do you usually eat? I make my own bento every night, and bring it to school to eat the next day. Like today I brought baked salmon, brown rice, and broccoli. Sounds very healthy. Besides diet, my sleep time is probably also not enough. I only sleep about five hours a day. Five hours is too little! Adults need to sleep at least seven to eight hours every day. What are you doing at night?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字，制定一個健康生活計畫。你打算在飲食、睡眠和運動上做什麼改變？你要『戒掉』什麼壞習慣？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '難怪 (nán guài)' 表示恍然大悟 (No wonder). '不知不覺' 表達沒有意識到時間的流逝。'不能再...下去了' 表示無法繼續忍受現狀。
examples: 他每天跑十公里，難怪這麼瘦。 (He runs 10km every day, no wonder he's so thin.)
看電影很有趣，不知不覺就過了兩小時。 (Watching the movie was interesting, before I knew it 2 hours passed.)
雨下得太大了，不能再走下去了。 (It's raining too heavily, we can't go on walking.)
戒掉壞習慣 (Quit a bad habit)
睡眠品質 (Sleep quality)

practice.q: Translate: No wonder you are angry.
Complete: 打遊戲___知___覺就天亮了。 (Before one knows it.)
Translate: I can't go on like this anymore.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我最近開始嘗試『一六八斷食法』。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ zuì jìn kāi shǐ cháng shì 'yī liù bā duàn shí fǎ'.
expansion_dialogue.en: I recently started trying the '16:8 intermittent fasting'.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 一六八斷食？那是什麼意思？
expansion_dialogue.py: yī liù bā duàn shí? nà shì shén me yì si?
expansion_dialogue.en: 16:8 fasting? What does that mean?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 就是每天有連續十六個小時不吃東西，只在剩下的八小時內進食。
expansion_dialogue.py: jiù shì měi tiān yǒu lián xù shí liù gè xiǎo shí bù chī dōng xi, zhǐ zài shèng xià de bā xiǎo shí nèi jìn shí.
expansion_dialogue.en: It means every day there are 16 consecutive hours of not eating, only eating within the remaining 8 hours.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 十六個小時不吃？那你不會覺得餓到受不了嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: shí liù gè xiǎo shí bù chī? nà nǐ bù huì jué de è dào shòu bù liǎo ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: 16 hours of not eating? Then won't you feel so hungry you can't bear it?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 前幾天會比較難受，但習慣了之後，覺得精神反而變好了，體重也減輕了一點。
expansion_dialogue.py: qián jǐ tiān huì bǐ jiào nán shòu, dàn xí guàn le zhī hòu, jué de jīng shén fǎn ér biàn hǎo le, tǐ zhòng yě jiǎn qīng le yī diǎn.
expansion_dialogue.en: The first few days are a bit uncomfortable, but after getting used to it, I feel my energy actually got better, and my weight decreased a bit.
