title: Feeling Stressed
story_description: 馬克最近面臨考試、打工和社交的多重壓力，感到喘不過氣。他向指導老師尋求建議。
story_intro: 期末考逼近，馬克的壓力越來越大。
他不僅要準備五門科目的考試，還要兼顧咖啡廳的打工。
他覺得時間根本不夠用，甚至開始失眠。
他決定去找學校的心理輔導老師聊聊。
老師給了他一些管理壓力的有效建議。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老師，您好。我最近覺得壓力好大，感覺快要喘不過氣了。
dialogue.py: lǎo shī, nín hǎo. wǒ zuì jìn jué de yā lì hǎo dà, gǎn jué kuài yào chuǎn bù guò qì le.
dialogue.en: Hello, Teacher. I feel so much stress lately; I feel like I'm almost unable to catch my breath.

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.zh: 馬克，請坐。慢慢說，是什麼事情讓你覺得壓力這麼大？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, qǐng zuò. màn màn shuō, shì shén me shì qing ràng nǐ jué de yā lì zhè me dà?
dialogue.en: Mark, please sit. Speak slowly, what is it that makes you feel such great stress?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 期末考快到了，我有五門課要考。同時我一週還要在咖啡廳打工三天。我真的沒有足夠的時間。
dialogue.py: qī mò kǎo kuài dào le, wǒ yǒu wǔ mén kè yào kǎo. tóng shí wǒ yī zhōu hái yào zài kā fēi tīng dǎ gōng sān tiān. wǒ zhēn de méi yǒu zú gòu de shí jiān.
dialogue.en: Final exams are almost here; I have five courses to test. At the same time, I still have to work at the coffee shop three days a week. I really don't have enough time.

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.zh: 聽起來你背負了很多責任。你最近的睡眠狀況好嗎？
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái nǐ bēi fù le hěn duō zé rèn. nǐ zuì jìn de shuì mián zhuàng kuàng hǎo ma?
dialogue.en: Sounds like you are bearing a lot of responsibilities. Is your recent sleep condition good?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 很糟。我晚上躺在床上，腦子裡全都是考試的內容和工作的事情，經常失眠。
dialogue.py: hěn zāo. wǒ wǎn shang tǎng zài chuáng shàng, nǎo zi lǐ quán dōu shì kǎo shì de nèi róng hé gōng zuò de shì qing, jīng cháng shī mián.
dialogue.en: Very bad. I lie in bed at night, and my brain is completely full of exam content and work matters; I frequently suffer from insomnia.

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.zh: 這是典型的壓力反應。當時間不夠時，我們需要學會『優先排序』。這五門課中，哪一門最緊急？
dialogue.py: zhè shì diǎn xíng de yā lì fǎn yìng. dāng shí jiān bù gòu shí, wǒ men xū yào xué huì 'yōu xiān pái xù'. zhè wǔ mén kè zhōng, nǎ yī mén zuì jǐn jí?
dialogue.en: This is a typical stress reaction. When time is not enough, we need to learn to 'prioritize'. Among these five courses, which one is the most urgent?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 經濟學最緊急，因為它是我的必修課，而且我很怕被當掉。
dialogue.py: jīng jì xué zuì jǐn jí, yīn wèi tā shì wǒ de bì xiū kè, ér qiě wǒ hěn pà bèi dāng diào.
dialogue.en: Economics is the most urgent, because it is my required course, and I'm very afraid of being failed.

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.zh: 那就把大部分的精力放在經濟學上。至於打工，你能不能考慮這兩週先請假，或者減少排班？
dialogue.py: nà jiù bǎ dà bù fèn de jīng lì fàng zài jīng jì xué shàng. zhì yú dǎ gōng, nǐ néng bù néng kǎo lǜ zhè liǎng zhōu xiān qǐng jià, huò zhě jiǎn shǎo pái bān?
dialogue.en: Then put the majority of your energy on economics. As for the part-time job, can you consider asking for leave for these two weeks, or reducing the shifts?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我有點不好意思跟經理開口，怕他覺得我不負責任。
dialogue.py: wǒ yǒu diǎn bù hǎo yì si gēn jīng lǐ kāi kǒu, pà tā jué de wǒ bù fù zé rèn.
dialogue.en: I'm a bit embarrassed to open my mouth to the manager; I'm afraid he will think I'm irresponsible.

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.zh: 誠實地溝通才是負責任的表現。你可以告訴他你需要專心準備期末考，相信他會理解的。
dialogue.py: chéng shí de gōu tōng cái shì fù zé rèn de biǎo xiàn. nǐ kě yǐ gào su tā nǐ xū yào zhuān xīn zhǔn bèi qī mò kǎo, xiāng xìn tā huì lǐ jiě de.
dialogue.en: Communicating honestly is exactly the expression of being responsible. You can tell him you need to concentrate on preparing for finals; believe he will understand.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我今天下午就去跟經理談談。那失眠的問題怎麼辦呢？
dialogue.py: èn, wǒ jīn tiān xià wǔ jiù qù gēn jīng lǐ tán tan. nà shī mián de wèn tí zěn me bàn ne?
dialogue.en: Mm, I'll go talk to the manager this afternoon. Then what about the insomnia problem?

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.zh: 試著在睡前做一些放鬆的練習，比如冥想或者深呼吸。最重要的是，不要把白天的煩惱帶到床上。
dialogue.py: shì zhe zài shuì qián zuò yī xiē fàng sōng de liàn xí, bǐ rú míng xiǎng huò zhě shēn hū xī. zuì zhòng yào de shì, bù yào bǎ bái tiān de fán nǎo dài dào chuáng shàng.
dialogue.en: Try doing some relaxation exercises before bed, such as meditation or deep breathing. The most important thing is, do not bring the daytime's worries to bed.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不要把煩惱帶到床上...我會努力嘗試的。
dialogue.py: bù yào bǎ fán nǎo dài dào chuáng shàng... wǒ huì nǔ lì cháng shì de.
dialogue.en: Don't bring worries to bed... I will try hard to attempt it.

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.zh: 記住，你不需要追求完美，盡力就好。如果覺得扛不住了，隨時可以來找我聊聊。
dialogue.py: jì zhù, nǐ bù xū yào zhuī qiú wán měi, jìn lì jiù hǎo. rú guǒ jué de káng bù zhù le, suí shí kě yǐ lái zhǎo wǒ liáo liao.
dialogue.en: Remember, you don't need to pursue perfection, doing your best is enough. If you feel you can't bear it anymore, you can come find me to chat anytime.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師，我現在覺得沒那麼恐慌了。
dialogue.py: xiè xie lǎo shī, wǒ xiàn zài jué de méi nà me kǒng huāng le.
dialogue.en: Thank you Teacher, I feel not so panicked now.

key_sentences.en: Brain is completely full of exam content.

passage.title: Feeling Stressed Listening Passage
passage.zh: 期末考逼近，馬克的壓力越來越大。他不僅要準備五門科目的考試，還要兼顧咖啡廳的打工。他覺得時間根本不夠用，甚至開始失眠。他決定去找學校的心理輔導老師聊聊。老師給了他一些管理壓力的有效建議。
passage.en: Hello, Teacher. I feel so much stress lately; I feel like I'm almost unable to catch my breath. Mark, please sit. Speak slowly, what is it that makes you feel such great stress? Final exams are almost here; I have five courses to test. At the same time, I still have to work at the coffee shop three days a week. I really don't have enough time. Sounds like you are bearing a lot of responsibilities. Is your recent sleep condition good? Very bad. I lie in bed at night, and my brain is completely full of exam content and work matters; I frequently suffer from insomnia. This is a typical stress reaction. When time is not enough, we need to learn to 'prioritize'. Among these five courses, which one is the most urgent? Economics is the most urgent, because it is my required course, and I'm very afraid of being failed.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字給感到壓力的朋友。表達你的理解與同情，並給他兩個減輕壓力的具體建議（例如：如何安排時間或如何放鬆）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '喘不過氣' 形容極大的壓力或疲憊。'被當掉' 是台灣校園流行語，意指不及格(fail a class)。'才 (cái)' 用於強調唯一的條件或正確的事物 (誠實溝通才是負責任的表現)。
examples: 他忙得喘不過氣來。 (He is so busy he can hardly catch his breath.)
如果你不念書，一定會被當掉。 (If you don't study, you will definitely be failed.)
健康才是最重要的。 (Health is exactly what's most important.)
優先排序 (Prioritize)
盡力就好 (Doing one's best is enough)

title: Making a Budget
story_description: 馬克發現他這個月的開銷超支了，決定和朋友大衛一起討論如何制定預算並省錢。
story_intro: 馬克最近發現他的銀行存款越來越少。
他看了一下手機銀行的帳單，嚇了一跳。
他這個月花了很多錢在吃大餐和買衣服上。
他決定請教擅長理財的大衛。
大衛教他如何記錄開銷並制定每月的預算。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，我遇到大麻煩了。我剛看了這個月的帳單，我的存款快要見底了。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, wǒ yù dào dà má fan le. wǒ gāng kàn le zhè ge yuè de zhàng dān, wǒ de cún kuǎn kuài yào jiàn dǐ le.
dialogue.en: David, I've run into big trouble. I just looked at this month's bill; my savings are almost hitting bottom.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，這很常見。你是不是這個月買了什麼大件物品？
dialogue.py: bié dān xīn, zhè hěn cháng jiàn. nǐ shì bú shì zhè ge yuè mǎi le shén me dà jiàn wù pǐn?
dialogue.en: Don't worry, this is very common. Did you buy some big-ticket items this month?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 也沒有。就是常和朋友出去吃大餐，還在網上買了幾件名牌衣服。
dialogue.py: yě méi yǒu. jiù shì cháng hé péng you chū qù chī dà cān, hái zài wǎng shàng mǎi le jǐ jiàn míng pái yī fu.
dialogue.en: Not really. It's just often going out for big meals with friends, and also bought a few branded clothes online.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 小開銷累積起來是很驚人的。你有記帳的習慣嗎？
dialogue.py: xiǎo kāi xiāo lěi jī qǐ lái shì hěn jīng rén de. nǐ yǒu jì zhàng de xí guàn ma?
dialogue.en: Small expenses accumulating can be very startling. Do you have the habit of keeping accounts?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒有。我總覺得隨便花花應該沒關係，結果不知不覺就超支了。
dialogue.py: méi yǒu. wǒ zǒng jué de suí biàn huā huā yīng gāi méi guān xi, jié guǒ bù zhī bù jué jiù chāo zhī le.
dialogue.en: No. I always felt spending a bit here and there should be okay, as a result I overspent before I knew it.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 這就是問題所在。你首先要做的就是制定一個每月的預算計畫。
dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì wèn tí suǒ zài. nǐ shǒu xiān yào zuò de jiù shì zhì dìng yī gè měi yuè de yù suàn jì huà.
dialogue.en: This is exactly where the problem lies. The first thing you need to do is formulate a monthly budget plan.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 預算？聽起來很複雜。我要怎麼分呢？
dialogue.py: yù suàn? tīng qǐ lái hěn fù zá. wǒ yào zěn me fēn ne?
dialogue.en: Budget? Sounds very complicated. How should I divide it?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你可以分成『固定支出』和『變動支出』。固定支出包括房租、手機費和學費。
dialogue.py: kě yǐ fēn chéng 'gù dìng zhī chū' hé 'biàn dòng zhī chū'. gù dìng zhī chū bāo kuò fáng zū, shǒu jī fèi hé xué fèi.
dialogue.en: You can divide it into 'fixed expenses' and 'variable expenses'. Fixed expenses include rent, mobile phone bills, and tuition.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那吃飯和娛樂就是變動支出囉？
dialogue.py: nà chī fàn hé yú lè jiù shì biàn dòng zhī chū luo?
dialogue.en: Then eating and entertainment are variable expenses?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。你要規定自己每個月在變動支出上不能超過一定的金額。
dialogue.py: méi cuò. nǐ yào guī dìng zì jǐ měi gè yuè zài biàn dòng zhī chū shàng bù néng chāo guò yī dìng de jīn é.
dialogue.en: Exactly. You need to stipulate for yourself that every month you cannot exceed a certain amount in variable expenses.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我明白了。那我應該從哪裡開始省錢呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ míng bai le. nà wǒ yīng gāi cóng nǎ lǐ kāi shǐ shěng qián ne?
dialogue.en: I understand. Then where should I start saving money?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 最簡單的方法就是減少外食。自己做飯不僅健康，還能省下不少服務費。
dialogue.py: zuì jiǎn dān de fāng fǎ jiù shì jiǎn shǎo wài shí. zì jǐ zuò fàn bù jǐn jiàn kāng, hái néng shěng xià bù shǎo fú wù fèi.
dialogue.en: The simplest method is to reduce eating out. Cooking for yourself is not only healthy, but also saves a lot of service fees.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你說得對。我也要停止衝動購物，買東西前先問自己是『需要』還是『想要』。
dialogue.py: nǐ shuō de duì. wǒ yě yào tíng zhǐ chōng dòng gòu wù, mǎi dōng xi qián xiān wèn zì jǐ shì 'xū yào' hái shì 'xiǎng yào'.
dialogue.en: You're right. I also need to stop impulsive shopping, and before buying things first ask myself if it's a 'need' or a 'want'.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 很好！如果你能堅持三個月，你的存款一定會慢慢增加的。
dialogue.py: hěn hǎo! rú guǒ nǐ néng jiān chí sān gè yuè, nǐ de cún kuǎn yī dìng huì màn màn zēng jiā de.
dialogue.en: Very good! If you can persist for three months, your savings will definitely increase slowly.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你的建議，大衛。我今晚就去下載一個記帳軟體！
dialogue.py: xiè xie nǐ de jiàn yì, dà wèi. wǒ jīn wǎn jiù qù xià zài yī gè jì zhàng ruǎn tǐ!
dialogue.en: Thank you for your advice, David. I'll go download an accounting app tonight!

key_sentences.zh: 分為固定支出和變動支出。
key_sentences.en: Divided into fixed and variable expenses.
Cannot exceed a certain amount of money.
Reduce eating out, cook for oneself.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你告訴朋友你這個月花太多錢了。朋友問你錢花在哪裡，你說花在買電子產品和吃好料。朋友建議你開始記帳並分清『需要』和『想要』。
part_c: 你有記帳的習慣嗎？你覺得記帳有用嗎？
你覺得省錢最難的部分是什麼？

options: B. 他的存款快用完了

comprehension.q: 馬克這個月把錢花在了哪些地方？
options: B. 出去吃大餐和買名牌衣服

comprehension.q: 大衛建議馬克制定的計畫叫什麼？

options: B. 減少外食，自己做飯

passage.title: Making a Budget Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克最近發現他的銀行存款越來越少。他看了一下手機銀行的帳單，嚇了一跳。他這個月花了很多錢在吃大餐和買衣服上。他決定請教擅長理財的大衛。大衛教他如何記錄開銷並制定每月的預算。
passage.en: David, I've run into big trouble. I just looked at this month's bill; my savings are almost hitting bottom. Don't worry, this is very common. Did you buy some big-ticket items this month? Not really. It's just often going out for big meals with friends, and also bought a few branded clothes online. Small expenses accumulating can be very startling. Do you have the habit of keeping accounts? No. I always felt spending a bit here and there should be okay, as a result I overspent before I knew it. This is exactly where the problem lies. The first thing you need to do is formulate a monthly budget plan. Budget? Sounds very complicated. How should I divide it?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字，描述你個人的理財或預算計畫。你每個月最大的支出是什麼？你打算如何減少不必要的開銷？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '累積起來' 表示數量逐漸增加。'不知不覺' 表達在沒有意識的情況下發生。'區分 A 和 B' 表示辨別兩者的不同。
examples: 經驗累積起來對工作很有幫助。 (Accumulated experience is very helpful for work.)
不知不覺就到了晚上。 (Before I knew it, it was evening.)
你得學會區分『需要』和『想要』。 (You have to learn to distinguish between 'need' and 'want'.)
制定計畫 (Formulate a plan)
減少支出 (Reduce expenses)

practice.q: Complete: 打遊戲___知___覺就半夜了。 (Before one knows it.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這件毛衣打五折，只要五百塊，好划算喔！
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè jiàn máo yī dǎ wǔ zhé, zhǐ yào wǔ bǎi kuài, hǎo huá suàn ō!
expansion_dialogue.en: This sweater is 50% off, only 500 dollars, such a good deal!

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 可是你家裡已經有十幾件毛衣了，這不是『需要』，而是『想要』。
expansion_dialogue.py: kě shì nǐ jiā lǐ yǐ jīng yǒu shí jǐ jiàn máo yī le, zhè bú shì 'xū yào', ér shì 'xiǎng yào'.
expansion_dialogue.en: But you already have more than a dozen sweaters at home; this is not a 'need', but a 'want'.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你說得對。為了省錢去歐洲旅行，我應該忍住。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ shuō de duì. wèi le shěng qián qù ōu zhōu lǚ xíng, wǒ yīng gāi rěn zhù.
expansion_dialogue.en: You're right. To save money for a trip to Europe, I should hold back.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這才對嘛。把錢花在刀口上，才能實現你的長期目標。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè cái duì ma. bǎ qián huā zài dāo kǒu shàng, cái néng shí xiàn nǐ de cháng qī mù biāo.
expansion_dialogue.en: That's more like it. Spend money only where it's truly necessary to achieve your long-term goals.

title: Saving for Something
story_description: 馬克有一個夢想，他想在明年暑假去日本旅行。他正在制定一個具體的存錢計畫來實現這個目標。
story_intro: 馬克一直很想去京都看櫻花。
他估計這趟旅行大約需要六萬塊台幣。
他現在的存款只有一萬塊。
他決定從現在開始，每個月強迫自己存下一萬塊。
他告訴他的朋友莉莉這個計畫，尋求鼓勵。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 莉莉，我決定了！明年夏天我一定要去日本旅行十天。
dialogue.py: lì lì, wǒ jué dìng le! míng nián xià tiān wǒ yī dìng yào qù rì běn lǚ xíng shí tiān.
dialogue.en: Lily, I've decided! Next summer I absolutely must go to Japan for a ten-day trip.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 哇，那太棒了！日本很漂亮，但物價不便宜喔。你準備好錢了嗎？
dialogue.py: wa, nà tài bàng le! rì běn hěn piào liang, dàn wù jià bù pián yi ō. nǐ zhǔn bèi hǎo qián le ma?
dialogue.en: Wow, that's great! Japan is beautiful, but the prices aren't cheap. Have you prepared the money?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我算了一下，機票、住宿和生活費加起來大約要六萬塊。我現在只有一萬塊存款。
dialogue.py: wǒ suàn le yī xià, jī piào, zhù sù hé shēng huó fèi jiā qǐ lái dà yuē yào liù wàn kuài. wǒ xiàn zài zhǐ yǒu yī wàn kuài cún kuǎn.
dialogue.en: I did some math; airfare, accommodation, and living expenses together will cost about 60,000 dollars. I only have 10,000 in savings right now.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 所以你還差五萬塊。距離明年夏天還有五個月，也就是說，你每個月得存一萬塊。
dialogue.py: suǒ yǐ nǐ hái chà wǔ wàn kuài. jù lí míng nián xià tiān hái yǒu wǔ gè yuè, yě jiù shì shuō, nǐ měi gè yuè děi cún yī wàn kuài.
dialogue.en: So you're still short 50,000. It's still five months until next summer, which means you have to save 10,000 every month.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，這對我來說是一大挑戰。但我打算強迫自己存錢。
dialogue.py: duì, zhè duì wǒ lái shuō shì yī dà tiǎo zhàn. dàn wǒ dǎ suàn qiáng pò zì jǐ cún qián.
dialogue.en: Yes, this is a big challenge for me. But I plan to force myself to save money.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 強迫存錢？你要怎麼做？
dialogue.py: qiáng pò cún qián? nǐ yào zěn me zuò?
dialogue.en: Force save? How are you going to do it?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我辦了一個新的銀行帳戶，每個月領到薪水後，馬上先把一萬塊轉進去，不能領出來。
dialogue.py: wǒ bàn le yī gè xīn de yín háng zhàng hù, měi gè rén lǐng dào xīn shuǐ hòu, mǎ shàng xiān bǎ yī wàn kuài zhuǎn jìn qù, bù néng lǐng chū lái.
dialogue.en: I opened a new bank account; as soon as I get my salary each month, I'll immediately transfer 10,000 in first, and I can't withdraw it.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 這個方法很好！這就是所謂的『先存再花』。那你的生活費夠用嗎？
dialogue.py: zhè ge fāng fǎ hěn hǎo! zhè jiù shì suǒ wèi de 'xiān cún zài huā'. nà nǐ de shēng huó fèi gòu yòng ma?
dialogue.en: This method is good! This is what's called 'save first, spend later'. Then is your living money enough?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我打算多接一點家教的工作。而且，我已經戒掉每天買拿鐵的習慣了。
dialogue.py: wǒ dǎ suàn duō jiē yī diǎn jiā jiào de gōng zuò. ér qiě, wǒ yǐ jīng jiè diào měi tiān mǎi ná tiě de xí guàn le.
dialogue.en: I plan to take on a few more tutoring jobs. Also, I've already quit the habit of buying a latte every day.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 一杯拿鐵一百多塊，一個月省下來也能存三、四千塊呢。
dialogue.py: yī bēi ná tiě yī bǎi duō kuài, yī gè yuè shěng xià lái yě néng cún sān, sì qiān kuài ne.
dialogue.en: A latte is over 100 dollars; saving it for a month can also save three or four thousand dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。我還把日本風景的照片設成手機桌布，隨時提醒自己要忍耐。
dialogue.py: méi cuò. wǒ hái bǎ rì běn fēng jǐng de zhào piàn shè chéng shǒu jī zhuō bù, suí shí tí xǐng zì jǐ yào rěn nài.
dialogue.en: Exactly. I also set a photo of Japanese scenery as my phone wallpaper to remind myself to be patient anytime.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 很有決心喔！如果你真的存到了，我也想跟你一起去，我也該開始存錢了。
dialogue.py: hěn yǒu jué xīn ō! rú guǒ nǐ zhēn de cún dào le, wǒ yě xiǎng gēn nǐ yī qǐ qù, wǒ yě gāi kāi shǐ cún qián le.
dialogue.en: Very determined! If you really save enough, I also want to go with you; I should also start saving money.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？太好了！兩個人一起旅行更有趣。那我們互相監督，看誰先存到目標金額。
dialogue.py: zhēn de ma? tài hǎo le! liǎng gè rén yī qǐ lǚ xíng gèng yǒu qù. nà wǒ men hù xiāng jiān dū, kàn shuí xiān cún dào mù biāo jīn é.
dialogue.en: Really? Great! Traveling with two people is even more fun. Then let's supervise each other and see who reaches the target amount first.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 沒問題！為了日本櫻花，加油！
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí! wèi le rì běn yīng huā, jiā yóu!
dialogue.en: No problem! For the Japanese cherry blossoms, let's go!

key_sentences.zh: 估計這趟旅行需要六萬塊。
key_sentences.en: Estimate this trip will need 60,000 dollars.

key_sentences.zh: 薪水領到後，先轉帳進去。
key_sentences.en: After getting the salary, transfer money in first.

key_sentences.zh: 戒掉每天喝拿鐵的習慣。
key_sentences.en: Quit the habit of drinking lattes every day.

How are you going to do it? I opened a new bank account; as soon as I get my salary each month, I'll immediately transfer 10,000 in first, and I can't withdraw it.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字，描述你正在為之存錢的一個目標（例如買新手機、筆電或旅行）。你目前存了多少？你打算如何達成目標？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '還差...' 表示距離目標的差距。'所謂的...' 用於介紹一個概念或名稱。'互相...' 表示動作在雙方之間進行。
examples: 我還差兩塊錢。 (I'm still short two dollars.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我的筆電壞了，我想買一台新的 MacBook，但要四萬塊。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ de bǐ diàn huài le, wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī tái xīn de MacBook, dàn yào sì wàn kuài.
expansion_dialogue.en: My laptop is broken; I want to buy a new MacBook, but it costs 40,000.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那你打算怎麼存錢？這可不是一筆小金額。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà nǐ dǎ suàn zěn me cún qián? zhè kě bú shì yī bǐ xiǎo jīn é.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我打算把每個月的獎金都存起來。估計半年後就能買了。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ dǎ suàn bǎ měi gè yuè de jiǎng jīn dōu cún qǐ lái. gū jì bàn nián hòu jiù néng mǎi le.
expansion_dialogue.en: I plan to save all of my monthly bonuses. I estimate I can buy it in half a year.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.py: jiā yóu! mǎi dào zhī hòu, gōng zuò xiào lǜ yī dìng huì biàn gāo de.
expansion_dialogue.en: Go for it! After you buy it, your work efficiency will definitely become higher.

title: Comparing Prices Online
story_description: 馬克想買一副抗噪耳機，他正在網上比較不同平台的價格和網友的評論，希望能買到最划算的產品。
story_intro: 馬克最近在圖書館讀書時，覺得環境有點吵。
他決定買一副抗噪耳機。
他在不同的購物網站上搜尋同一個型號。
他發現每個平台的優惠和贈品都不一樣。
他仔細閱讀了其他買家的評論，怕買到品質不好的貨。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，你對耳機有研究嗎？我想買這款抗噪耳機，但網上的價格差很多。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ duì ěr jī yǒu yán jiū ma? wǒ xiǎng mǎi zhè kuǎn kàng zào ěr jī, dàn wǎng shàng de jià gé chà hěn duō.
dialogue.en: David, do you have any knowledge about headphones? I want to buy these noise-canceling headphones, but the online prices vary a lot.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 這款很有名。你有在哪些平台比較過價格了嗎？
dialogue.py: zhè kuǎn hěn yǒu míng. nǐ yǒu zài nǎ xiē píng tái bǐ jiào guò jià gé le ma?
dialogue.en: This model is very famous. Have you compared prices on any platforms yet?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我在兩個主流網站上看過。第一個網站賣八千塊，但有送一年的保固。
dialogue.py: wǒ zài liǎng gè zhǔ liú wǎng zhàn shàng kàn guò. dì yī gè wǎng zhàn mài bā qiān kuài, dàn yǒu sòng yī nián de bǎo gù.
dialogue.en: I've looked at two mainstream websites. The first website sells them for 8,000, but gives a one-year warranty.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那第二個呢？
dialogue.py: nà dì èr gè ne?
dialogue.en: What about the second one?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 第二個網站只要七千五百塊，還免運費，但沒有送贈品。
dialogue.py: dì èr gè wǎng zhàn zhǐ yào qī qiān wǔ bǎi kuài, hái miǎn yùn fèi, dàn méi yǒu sòng zèng pǐn.
dialogue.en: The second website is only 7,500 and has free shipping, but no free gifts.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 這就是陷阱所在。你有看過買家的評價嗎？
dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì xiàn jǐng suǒ zài. nǐ yǒu kàn guò mǎi jiā de píng jià ma?
dialogue.en: This is where the trap lies. Have you seen the buyers' reviews?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我看了一下，七千五百塊那家的負評比較多，有人說收到的貨包裝很破爛，甚至懷疑是假貨。
dialogue.py: wǒ kàn le yī xià, qī qiān wǔ bǎi kuài nà jiā de fù píng bǐ jiào duō, yǒu rén shuō shōu dào de huò bāo zhuāng hěn pò làn, shèn zhì huái yí shì jiǎ huò.
dialogue.en: I took a look; the one for 7,500 has more negative reviews. Someone said the package they received was very ragged, and even suspected it was a fake.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那千萬不要買。便宜沒好貨。為了省五百塊買到假貨，反而更浪費錢。
dialogue.py: nà qiān wàn bù yào mǎi. pián yi méi hǎo huò. wèi le shěng wǔ bǎi kuài mǎi dào jiǎ huò, fǎn ér gèng làng fèi qián.
dialogue.en: Then definitely don't buy it. You get what you pay for. Saving 500 dollars but buying a fake is actually more of a waste of money.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你說得對。那八千塊那家呢？評價看起來都不錯，大部分的人都說音質很好，出貨速度也很快。
dialogue.py: nǐ shuō de duì. nà bā qiān kuài nà jiā ne? píng jià kàn qǐ lái dōu bù cuò, dà bù fèn de rén dōu shuō yīn zhì hěn hǎo, chū huò sù dù yě hěn kuài.
dialogue.en: You're right. How about the 8,000 one? The reviews look good; most people say the sound quality is great and the shipping speed is very fast.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那應該比較可靠。對了，你看看有沒有刷卡優惠或者紅利點數可以折抵？
dialogue.py: nà yīng gāi bǐ jiào kě kào. duì le, nǐ kàn kan yǒu méi yǒu shuā kǎ yōu huì huò zhě hóng lì diǎn shù kě yǐ zhé dǐ?
dialogue.en: That should be more reliable. By the way, check if there are credit card discounts or bonus points you can use for a deduction?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我查一下...哇！這張信用卡在那個網站消費可以回饋 5%，還可以分期付款！
dialogue.py: wǒ chá yī xià... wa! zhè zhāng xìn yòng kǎ zài nà ge wǎng zhàn xiāo fèi kě yǐ huí kuì 5%, hái kě yǐ fēn qī fù kuǎn!
dialogue.en: Let me check... Wow! This credit card gives 5% cashback for spending on that site, and I can even pay in installments!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那算下來其實不到七千七百塊。而且分期付款可以減輕你的財務壓力。
dialogue.py: nà suàn xià lái qí shí bú dào qī qiān qī bǎi kuài. ér qiě fēn qī fù kuǎn kě yǐ jiǎn qīng nǐ de cái wù yā lì.
dialogue.en: Then calculated, it's actually less than 7,700. Plus, paying in installments can lighten your financial pressure.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了！看來多花點時間比較是真的有必要的。我現在就下單。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le! kàn lái duō huā diǎn shí jiān bǐ jiào shì zhēn de yǒu bì yào de. wǒ xiàn zài jiù xià dān.
dialogue.en: Great! Looks like spending a bit more time to compare is truly necessary. I'll place the order now.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 恭喜你買到心目中的好耳機！
dialogue.py: gōng xǐ nǐ mǎi dào xīn mù zhōng de hǎo ěr jī!
dialogue.en: Congratulations on buying your ideal headphones!

key_sentences.en: This is exactly where the trap lies.
Cheap things are not good (You get what you pay for).
Bonus points can be used for a deduction.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你想買一支新手機。你在兩個網站看到不同價格：一個便宜但沒保固，一個貴一點但有兩年保固。你和朋友討論後決定買貴的那一個，因為比較可靠。
part_c: 你在網購時最看重什麼？價格、評價還是保固？
你相信『便宜沒好貨』這句話嗎？為什麼？

comprehension.q: 馬克為什麼想買抗噪耳機？
第一個網站賣八千塊，它的優點是什麼？
馬克為什麼不敢買七千五百塊的那一副？
options: B. 負評多，懷疑是假貨

comprehension.q: 大衛建議馬克檢查什麼優惠？
options: B. 刷卡優惠或紅利點數折抵

comprehension.q: 馬克的信用卡提供了什麼額外的功能？

true_false.q: 馬克在三個以上的購物網站比較過價格。
便宜沒好貨是指便宜的東西通常品質不好。
大衛認為分期付款可以增加財務壓力。
八千塊那家店的出貨速度很慢。
馬克最後決定在評價比較好的網站下單。

fill_blank.q: 我在網上比____不同平台的價格。
第一個網站有送一年的保____。
七千五百塊那家的____評比較多。
你可以用點數來折____現金。

passage.title: Comparing Prices Online Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克最近在圖書館讀書時，覺得環境有點吵。他決定買一副抗噪耳機。他在不同的購物網站上搜尋同一個型號。他發現每個平台的優惠和贈品都不一樣。他仔細閱讀了其他買家的評論，怕買到品質不好的貨。
passage.en: David, do you have any knowledge about headphones? I want to buy these noise-canceling headphones, but the online prices vary a lot. This model is very famous. Have you compared prices on any platforms yet? I've looked at two mainstream websites. The first website sells them for 8,000, but gives a one-year warranty. What about the second one? The second website is only 7,500 and has free shipping, but no free gifts. This is where the trap lies. Have you seen the buyers' reviews? I took a look; the one for 7,500 has more negative reviews. Someone said the package they received was very ragged, and even suspected it was a fake.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字，分享你的一次網購經驗。你買了什麼？你有沒有比較價格？你最後為什麼決定在那家店買？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '比較 A 和 B' 表達對比。'折抵' 用於描述優惠扣除。'分期付款' 是描述支付方式的重要詞彙。
examples: 這兩件衣服，哪件比較好看？ (Between these two clothes, which one looks better?)
點數可以折抵學費嗎？ (Can points be used to offset tuition? )
這台車可以分期付款。 (This car can be paid for in installments.)
便宜沒好貨 (You get what you pay for)
可靠的賣家 (Reliable seller)

practice.q: Translate: Can I pay in installments?
Translate: You get what you pay for.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我剛在網上訂了一台電視，比實體店便宜三千塊！
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ gāng zài wǎng shàng dìng le yī tái diàn shì, bǐ shí tǐ diàn pián yi sān qiān kuài!
expansion_dialogue.en: I just ordered a TV online; it's 3,000 cheaper than in the physical store!

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 便宜這麼多？你要小心是不是福利品或者整新品。
expansion_dialogue.py: pián yi zhè me duō? nǐ yào xiǎo xīn shì bú shì fú lì pǐn huò zhě zhěng xīn pǐn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Cheaper by that much? You should be careful if it's a display item or a refurbished one.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我看過評價了，是全新品，而且還有原廠保固。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ kàn guò píng jià le, shì quán xīn pǐn, ér qiě hái yǒu yuán chǎng bǎo gù.
expansion_dialogue.en: I've seen the reviews; it's a brand new item, and there's also the original manufacturer's warranty.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那真的很划算。網購前真的要多做功課。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà zhēn de hěn huá suàn. wǎng gòu qián zhēn de yào duō zuò gōng kè.
expansion_dialogue.en: Then it's really a good deal. You really have to do your homework before shopping online.

review.speaking: Explain how to compare products online and what to look out for (reviews, warranty).
review.writing: Write a 70-word paragraph about your online shopping criteria.
review.self_check: 你能用中文比較價格、討論『保固』與『評價』並解釋『分期付款』嗎？

title: Online Delivery Problem
story_description: 馬克在網上訂的耳機終於送到了，但他打開包裹後發現顏色錯了，而且耳機上有一道刮痕。他打電話給客服要求退換貨。
story_intro: 馬克期待已久的耳機終於寄到了。
他興奮地拆開包裹，卻發現顏色不對。
他訂的是黑色，送來的卻是白色。
更糟糕的是，耳機表面有一道明顯的刮痕。
馬克感到非常失望，立刻聯絡了客服中心。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想投訴一個訂單問題。我收到的商品跟訂購的不符。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng tóu sù yī gè dìng dān wèn tí. wǒ shōu dào de shāng pǐn gēn dìng gòu de bù fú.
dialogue.en: Hello, I want to complain about an order problem. The product I received does not match what was ordered.

dialogue.speaker: CS
dialogue.zh: 先生您好，很抱歉給您帶來不便。請提供您的訂單編號，我幫您查詢一下。
dialogue.py: xiān sheng nín hǎo, hěn bào qiàn gěi nín dài lái bù biàn. qǐng tí gōng nín de dìng dān biān hào, wǒ bāng nín chá xún yī xià.
dialogue.en: Hello sir, very sorry for the inconvenience caused. Please provide your order number; I will look it up for you.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我的訂單編號是 ABC-12345。我訂的是黑色抗噪耳機。
dialogue.py: wǒ de dìng dān biān hào shì ABC-12345. wǒ dìng de shì hēi sè kàng zào ěr jī.
dialogue.en: My order number is ABC-12345. I ordered black noise-canceling headphones.

dialogue.speaker: CS
dialogue.zh: 好的，系統顯示您確實訂購了黑色。請問您收到的是什麼顏色？
dialogue.py: hǎo de, xì tǒng xiǎn shì nín què shí dìng gòu le hēi sè. qǐng wèn nín shōu dào de shì shén me yán sè?
dialogue.en: Okay, the system shows you indeed ordered black. What color did you receive?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我收到的是白色的。而且，左邊的耳機殼上有一道很深的刮痕。
dialogue.py: wǒ shōu dào de shì bái sè de. ér qiě, zuǒ biān de ěr jī ké shàng yǒu yī dào hěn shēn de guā hén.
dialogue.en: I received white ones. Furthermore, there is a very deep scratch on the left earphone shell.

dialogue.speaker: CS
dialogue.zh: 非常抱歉。這可能是物流過程中的疏忽，或者是倉庫發錯貨了。
dialogue.py: fēi cháng bào qiàn. zhè kě néng shì wù liú guò chéng zhōng de shū hu, huò zhě shì cāng kù fā cuò huò le.
dialogue.en: Very sorry. This might be negligence during the logistics process, or the warehouse sent the wrong item.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這讓我困擾。我本來打算這週末帶出國使用的。現在該怎麼辦？
dialogue.py: zhè ràng wǒ kùn rǎo. wǒ běn lái dǎ suàn zhè zhōu mò dài chū guó shǐ yòng de. xiàn zài gāi zěn me bàn?
dialogue.en: This troubles me. I originally planned to take it abroad to use this weekend. What should I do now?

dialogue.speaker: CS
dialogue.zh: 我們可以為您辦理退貨或者是更換全新品。如果您急著用，我建議辦理換貨。
dialogue.py: wǒ men kě yǐ wèi nín bàn lǐ tuì huò huò zhě shì gēng huàn quán xīn pǐn. rú guǒ nǐ jí zhe yòng, wǒ jiàn yì bàn lǐ huàn huò.
dialogue.en: We can process a return or a replacement for a brand-new item. If you are in a rush to use it, I suggest processing an exchange.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 換貨需要多久？這週五之前能送到嗎？
dialogue.py: huàn huò xū yào duō jiǔ? zhè zhōu wǔ zhī qián néng sòng dào ma?
dialogue.en: How long will the exchange take? Can it be delivered before this Friday?

dialogue.speaker: CS
dialogue.zh: 我會幫您申請特急件。請您先把商品放回原包裝，我們會安排快遞明天去收貨，同時把新的商品送過去。
dialogue.py: wǒ huì bāng nín shēn qǐng tè jí jiàn. qǐng nín xiān bǎ shāng pǐn fàng huí yuán bāo zhuāng, wǒ men huì ān pái kuài dì míng tiān qù shōu huò, tóng shí bǎ xīn de shāng pǐn sòng guò qù.
dialogue.en: I will apply for an express priority for you. Please first put the product back in its original packaging; we will arrange for a courier to pick it up tomorrow and simultaneously deliver the new product.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這樣最好。需要我提供刮痕的照片嗎？
dialogue.py: zhè yàng zuì hǎo. xū yào wǒ tí gōng guā hén de zhào piàn ma?
dialogue.en: That's best. Do I need to provide photos of the scratch?

dialogue.speaker: CS
dialogue.zh: 是的，請您拍下商品和外箱的照片，寄到我們的客服信箱，以便存檔。
dialogue.py: shì de, qǐng nín pāi xià shāng pǐn hé wài xiāng de zhào piàn, jì dào wǒ men de kè fú xìn xiāng, yǐ biàn cún dǎng.
dialogue.en: Yes, please take photos of the product and the outer box and send them to our customer service email for filing purposes.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，我馬上寄。希望這次不要再出錯了。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ mǎ shàng jì. xī wàng zhè cì bù yào zài chū cuò le.
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll send them immediately. I hope there won't be another mistake this time.

dialogue.speaker: CS
dialogue.zh: 保證不會。再次對造成您的困擾表示抱歉。祝您有愉快的一天。
dialogue.py: bǎo zhèng bú huì. zài cì duì zào chéng nín de kùn rǎo biǎo shì bào qiàn. zhù nín yǒu yú kuài de yī tiān.
dialogue.en: I guarantee there won't be. Once again, I apologize for causing you trouble. Have a pleasant day.

key_sentences.zh: 收到的商品跟訂購的不符。
key_sentences.en: The received product does not match what was ordered.
This makes me feel very troubled.
Apply for an express priority (urgent) item.
Put the product back in its original packaging.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你收到在網上訂的運動鞋，但尺寸錯了。你打給客服，客服查了訂單編號後道歉，並承諾明天會派快遞來換貨。你要求這週五前送到。
part_c: 你曾經有過糟糕的網購經驗嗎？你是如何處理的？
你覺得客服的態度對你來說重要嗎？為什麼？

options: B. 顏色錯了且有刮痕

comprehension.q: 馬克訂的是什麼顏色？收到的又是什麼顏色？
客服認為出錯的原因可能是什麼？

passage.title: Online Delivery Problem Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克期待已久的耳機終於寄到了。他興奮地拆開包裹，卻發現顏色不對。他訂的是黑色，送來的卻是白色。更糟糕的是，耳機表面有一道明顯的刮痕。馬克感到非常失望，立刻聯絡了客服中心。
passage.en: Hello, I want to complain about an order problem. The product I received does not match what was ordered. Hello sir, very sorry for the inconvenience caused. Please provide your order number; I will look it up for you. My order number is ABC-12345. I ordered black noise-canceling headphones. Okay, the system shows you indeed ordered black. What color did you receive? I received white ones. Furthermore, there is a very deep scratch on the left earphone shell. Very sorry. This might be negligence during the logistics process, or the warehouse sent the wrong item. This troubles me. I originally planned to take it abroad to use this weekend. What should I do now?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字的投訴郵件。說明你的訂單編號、遇到的具體問題（例如收錯貨、商品損壞），並提出你希望的解決方案（退貨、換貨或退款）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '跟...不符' 表達不一致。'帶來不便' 是一句常見的客套語。'以便' 用於引導目的 (為了更方便做某事)。
examples: 這張照片跟本人不符。 (This photo does not match the person.)
很抱歉給您帶來不便。 (Very sorry for bringing you inconvenience.)
請留下電話，以便聯絡。 (Please leave your number, so as to be contacted.)
造成困擾 (Cause trouble)
申請特急件 (Apply for priority item)

practice.q: Translate: Does not match the order.
Translate: Please send photos so as to file them.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我的外送餐點已經超過一個小時還沒送到。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ de wài sòng cān diǎn yǐ jīng chāo guò yī gè xiǎo shí hái méi sòng dào.
expansion_dialogue.en: My food delivery has already exceeded one hour and hasn't arrived yet.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你有聯絡外送員嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ yǒu lián luò wài sòng yuán ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Did you contact the delivery driver?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 聯絡不上。我現在想取消訂單並退款。
expansion_dialogue.py: lián luò bù shàng. wǒ xiàn zài xiǎng qǔ xiāo dìng dān bìng tuì kuǎn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Can't contact them. Now I want to cancel the order and get a refund.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你可以直接在 App 裡點選『線上客服』，他們處理退款的速度很快。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ kě yǐ zhí jiē zài App lǐ diǎn xuǎn 'xiàn shàng kè fú', tā men chǔ lǐ tuì kuǎn de sù dù hěn kuài.
expansion_dialogue.en: You can directly click 'online customer service' in the App; their speed of processing refunds is very fast.

title: Social Media Post
story_description: 馬克剛從台北的陽明山健行回來，拍了很多美照。他想在 Instagram 上發文分享，但不知道該怎麼寫有趣的文案，於是請莉莉幫忙。
story_intro: 馬克週末去陽明山看芒草，拍到了漂亮的風景照片。
他想把照片發到社群媒體上。
他希望文案能吸引朋友點讚和留言。
莉莉是一位社群媒體達人，常分享生活點滴。
他們一起討論如何用簡單又生動的句子寫文案。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 莉莉，幫我看看這張照片。這是我週六在陽明山頂拍的，風景很壯觀吧？
dialogue.py: lì lì, bāng wǒ kàn kan zhè zhāng zhào piàn. zhè shì wǒ zhōu liù zài yáng míng shān dǐng pāi de, fēng jǐng hěn zhuàng guān ba?
dialogue.en: Lily, help me look at this photo. This is what I took on the top of Yangmingshan on Saturday; the scenery is spectacular, right?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 哇！這雲海和芒草拍得真好。你一定要發到 Instagram 上。
dialogue.py: wa! zhè yún hǎi hé máng cǎo pāi de zhēn hǎo. nǐ yī dìng yào fā dào Instagram shàng.
dialogue.en: Wow! This sea of clouds and silver grass are shot really well. You absolutely must post it on Instagram.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我也想發，但我不知道文案要寫什麼。只寫『爬山好累』好像太無趣了。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě xiǎng fā, dàn wǒ bù zhī dào wén àn yào xiě shén me. zhǐ xiě 'pá shān hǎo lèi' hǎo xiàng tài wú qù le.
dialogue.en: I want to post it too, but I don't know what to write for the caption. Just writing 'hiking is so tiring' seems too boring.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 寫文案要掌握『生動』和『互動』。你可以先描述一下當下的感覺。
dialogue.py: xiě wén àn yào zhǎng wò 'shēng dòng' hé 'hù dòng'. nǐ kě yǐ xiān miáo shù yī xià dāng xià de gǎn jué.
dialogue.en: Writing captions requires mastering 'vividness' and 'interaction'. You can first describe the feeling of the moment.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 嗯...雖然爬山的過程很辛苦，但看到美景的那一刻，覺得一切都值得了。
dialogue.py: èn... suī rán pá shān de guò chéng hěn xīn kǔ, dàn kàn dào měi jǐng de nà yī kè, jué de yī qiè dōu zhí de le.
dialogue.en: Mm... although the hiking process was very hard, at the moment I saw the beautiful view, I felt everything was worth it.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 這句很好！我們可以把它修飾一下：『流汗是為了遇見更好的風景，大自然真的太療癒了。』
dialogue.py: zhè jù hěn hǎo! wǒ men kě yǐ bǎ tā xiū shì yī xià: 'liú hàn shì wèi le yù jiàn gèng hǎo de fēng jǐng, dà zì rán zhēn de tài liáo yù le.'
dialogue.en: This sentence is great! We can polish it a bit: 'Sweating is for the sake of meeting better scenery; nature is truly too healing.'

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 『療癒』這個詞用得真好。那互動的部分呢？
dialogue.py: 'liáo yù' zhè ge cí yòng de zhēn hǎo. nà hù dòng de bù fèn ne?
dialogue.en: The word 'healing' is used really well. What about the interaction part?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 你可以問朋友一個問題，比如：『大家週末喜歡去山上還是海邊？』這樣大家就會留言回覆你。
dialogue.py: nǐ kě yǐ wèn péng you yī gè wèn tí, bǐ rú: 'dà jiā zhōu mò xǐ huān qù shān shàng hái shì hǎi biān?' zhè yàng dà jiā jiù huì liú yán huí fù nǐ.
dialogue.en: You can ask your friends a question, for example: 'Do you guys like going to the mountains or the seaside on weekends?' That way everyone will leave comments to reply to you.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好主意。標籤（Hashtag）的部分要怎麼加？
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì. biāo qiān (Hashtag) de bù fèn yào zěn me jiā?
dialogue.en: Good idea. How should I add the hashtags?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 加一些熱門的標籤，像是 #陽明山 #健行 #生活紀錄。這能增加貼文的曝光度。
dialogue.py: jiā yī xiē rè mén de biāo qiān, xiàng shì #yáng míng shān #jiàn xíng #shēng huó jì lù. zhè néng zēng jiā tiē wén de pù guāng dù.
dialogue.en: Add some popular tags, like #Yangmingshan #Hiking #LifeRecord. This can increase the exposure of the post.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我懂了。如果是發限時動態（Story）呢？是不是要更短一點？
dialogue.py: wǒ dǒng le. rú guǒ shì fā xiàn shí dòng tài (Story) ne? shì bú shì yào gèng duǎn yī diǎn?
dialogue.en: I see. What if it's posting a Story? Should it be even shorter?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 對，限時動態可以加一些可愛的貼圖，然後寫一句『今天的天氣給滿分』之類的，比較隨興。
dialogue.py: duì, xiàn shí dòng tài kě yǐ jiā yī xiē kě ài de tiē tú, rán hòu xiě yī jù 'jīn tiān de tiān qì gěi mǎn fēn' zhī lèi de, bǐ jiào suí xìng.
dialogue.en: Yes, for Stories you can add some cute stickers, and then write a sentence like 'giving today's weather a full score', which is more casual.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 莉莉你真是太專業了。我現在就發，看今天能不能破一百個讚！
dialogue.py: lì lì nǐ zhēn shì tài zhuān yè le. wǒ xiàn zài jiù fā, kàn jīn tiān néng bú néng pò yī bǎi gè zàn!
dialogue.en: Lily, you are truly too professional. I'll post it now and see if I can break a hundred likes today!

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我也會去幫你留言的！
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí, wǒ yě huì qù bāng nǐ liú yán de!
dialogue.en: No problem, I'll go leave a comment for you too!

passage.title: Social Media Post Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克週末去陽明山看芒草，拍到了漂亮的風景照片。他想把照片發到社群媒體上。他希望文案能吸引朋友點讚和留言。莉莉是一位社群媒體達人，常分享生活點滴。他們一起討論如何用簡單又生動的句子寫文案。
passage.en: Lily, help me look at this photo. This is what I took on the top of Yangmingshan on Saturday; the scenery is spectacular, right? Wow! This sea of clouds and silver grass are shot really well. You absolutely must post it on Instagram. I want to post it too, but I don't know what to write for the caption. Just writing 'hiking is so tiring' seems too boring. Writing captions requires mastering 'vividness' and 'interaction'. You can first describe the feeling of the moment. Mm... although the hiking process was very hard, at the moment I saw the beautiful view, I felt everything was worth it. This sentence is great! We can polish it a bit: 'Sweating is for the sake of meeting better scenery; nature is truly too healing.'. The word 'healing' is used really well. What about the interaction part?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫三則不同的社群媒體文案。一則關於『美景』，一則關於『美食』，一則關於『心情』。每則文案請包含一個描述句、一個問句和兩個標籤。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '...那一刻' 表示特定的時間點。'值得' 後面常接動詞，表示有價值去做。'給...滿分' 是一種誇獎的說法。
examples: 看到彩虹的那一刻，我很興奮。 (At the moment I saw the rainbow, I was very excited.)
這部電影值得看兩次。 (This movie is worth watching twice.)
這家店的服務我給滿分。 (I give full marks to the service of this store.)
掌握技巧 (Master skills)
破紀錄 (Break a record)

expansion_dialogue.zh: 我剛在 FB 發了合照，你有看到嗎？

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.py: āi yā, wǒ jué de hěn zì rán a. hǎo ba, wǒ xiān bǎ tā zhuǎn wèi 'jǐn xiàn zì jǐ kě jiàn'.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

title: Commenting Online Politely
story_description: 馬克看到一則關於氣候變遷的熱門貼文，留言區有很多激烈的爭論。他和大衛討論如何用禮貌的方式在網上表達不同意見。
story_intro: 馬克正在看新聞粉專下的留言。
有些人說話很不客氣，甚至互相攻擊。
馬克想加入討論，但怕引起不必要的爭吵。
大衛建議他在表達觀點時要保持客觀和禮貌。
他們練習了幾種委婉表達不同意的方法。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，你看這則貼文的留言區，大家吵得不可開交。網路上的戾氣真重。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ kàn zhè zé tiē wén de liú yán qū, dà jiā chǎo de bù kě kāi jiāo. wǎng lù shàng de lì qì zhēn zhòng.
dialogue.en: David, look at the comment section of this post; everyone is arguing inextricably. The hostility on the internet is really heavy.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 確實。匿名性讓很多人忘記了基本的禮貌。你打算留言嗎？
dialogue.py: què shí. nì míng xìng ràng hěn duō rén wàng jì le jī běn de lǐ mào. nǐ dǎ suàn liú yán ma?
dialogue.en: Indeed. Anonymity makes many people forget basic politeness. Are you planning to comment?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想分享我的看法，但我怕被網友攻擊。有些人根本不講道理。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng fēn xiǎng wǒ de kàn fǎ, dàn wǒ pà bèi wǎng yǒu gōng jí. yǒu xiē rén gēn běn bù jiǎng dào lǐ.
dialogue.en: I want to share my view, but I'm afraid of being attacked by netizens. Some people simply don't listen to reason.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 如果你想表達不同意見，可以用『先肯定，再否定』的技巧。這叫委婉表達。
dialogue.py: rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng biǎo dá bù tóng yì jiàn, kě yǐ yòng 'xiān kěn dìng, zài fǒu dìng' de jì qiǎo. zhè jiào wěi wǎn biǎo dá.
dialogue.en: If you want to express a different opinion, you can use the 'affirm first, then negate' technique. This is called tactful expression.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 『先肯定，再否定』？能不能舉個例子？
dialogue.py: 'xiān kěn dìng, zài fǒu dìng'? néng bù néng jǔ gè lì zi?
dialogue.en: 'Affirm first, then negate'? Can you give an example?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 比如你可以說：『我很贊同你提到的一點，但關於...的部分，我有不同的看法。』
dialogue.py: bǐ rú nǐ kě yǐ shuō: 'wǒ hěn zàn tóng nǐ tí dào de yī diǎn, dàn guān yú... de bù fèn, wǒ yǒu bù tóng de kàn fǎ.'
dialogue.en: For example, you can say: 'I very much agree with one point you mentioned, but regarding the part about..., I have a different view.'

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這聽起來確實比『你說錯了』好多了。那如果我想說別人的數據有誤呢？
dialogue.py: zhè tīng qǐ lái què shí bǐ 'nǐ shuō cuò le' hǎo duō le. nà rú guǒ wǒ xiǎng shuō bié rén de shù jù yǒu wù ne?
dialogue.en: This indeed sounds much better than 'you are wrong'. What if I want to say someone's data is erroneous?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你可以說：『根據我查到的資料，這組數據似乎有點落差，或許我們可以再確認一下。』
dialogue.py: kě yǐ shuō: 'gēn jù wǒ chá dào de zī liào, zhè zǔ shù jù sì hū yǒu diǎn luò chā, huò xǔ wǒ men kě yǐ zài què rèn yī xià.'
dialogue.en: You can say: 'According to the data I found, this set of data seems to have a bit of a gap; perhaps we can confirm it again.'

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 用『似乎』和『或許』，語氣就變得溫和很多，不會像在指責別人。
dialogue.py: yòng 'sì hū' hé 'huò xǔ', yǔ qì jiù biàn de wēn hé hěn duō, bú huì xiàng zài zhǐ zé bié rén.
dialogue.en: Using 'seems' and 'perhaps', the tone becomes much gentler, not like accusing others.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。還有，記得要『對事不對人』。討論事情本身，不要攻擊對方的個人特質。
dialogue.py: méi cuò. hái yǒu, jì de yào 'duì shì bú duì rén'. tǎo lùn shì qing běn shēn, bú yào gōng jí duì fāng de gè rén tè zhì.
dialogue.en: Exactly. Also, remember to 'be objective (focus on the matter, not the person)'. Discuss the matter itself; don't attack the other person's individual traits.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這很重要。有些人一吵架就開始罵人，真的很不文明。
dialogue.py: zhè zhòng yào. yǒu xiē rén yī chǎo jià jiù kāi shǐ mà rén, zhēn de bù wén míng.
dialogue.en: This is important. Some people start swearing as soon as they argue; it's really uncivilized.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 如果對方說話真的很難聽，最好的辦法就是不要理會。爭論這種事，有時候是浪費時間。
dialogue.py: rú guǒ duì fāng shuō huà zhēn de hěn nán tīng, zuì hǎo de fāng fǎ jiù shì bù yào lǐ huì. zhēng lùn zhè zhǒng shì, yǒu shí hou shì làng fèi shí jiān.
dialogue.en: If the other person says truly unpleasant things, the best method is to just ignore them. Arguing about this kind of thing is sometimes a waste of time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 懂了。保持理性，用理性的方式溝通。我現在試著留言看看。
dialogue.py: dǒng le. bǎo chí lǐ xìng, yòng lǐ xìng de fāng fǎ gōu tōng. wǒ xiàn zài shì zhe liú yán kàn kàn.
dialogue.en: I get it. Maintain rationality, and communicate in a rational way. I'll try commenting now and see.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 加油，做一個有素質的網民！
dialogue.py: jiā yóu, zuò yī gè yǒu sù zhì de wǎng mín!
dialogue.en: Go for it, be a netizen with high quality/standard!

key_sentences.en: Arguing inextricably / locked in a fierce argument.
The data seems to have a bit of a gap/discrepancy.
Focus on the matter, not the person.

key_sentences.zh: 最好的辦法就是不予理會。
key_sentences.en: The best method is to ignore it.
Be a netizen with high quality/standards.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 朋友在網上發了一篇關於『手機該不該進校園』的文章。你不太同意他的看法，但你想禮貌地留言。你練習大衛教的技巧：『我很贊同你說學生會分心，但或許手機也可以作為學習工具。』
part_c: 你覺得在網上留言時，最不應該做的事情是什麼？

B. 只攻擊人，不討論事情

comprehension.q: 如果對方說話真的很難聽，大衛建議怎麼辦？
options: C. 不要理會，不要浪費時間

true_false.q: 馬克想留言，但擔心被網民攻擊。
大衛建議直接說『你說錯了』，這樣比較快。
使用『似乎』和『或許』可以讓語氣變得溫和。

passage.title: Commenting Online Politely Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克正在看新聞粉專下的留言。有些人說話很不客氣，甚至互相攻擊。馬克想加入討論，但怕引起不必要的爭吵。大衛建議他在表達觀點時要保持客觀和禮貌。他們練習了幾種委婉表達不同意的方法。
passage.en: David, look at the comment section of this post; everyone is arguing inextricably. The hostility on the internet is really heavy. Indeed. Anonymity makes many people forget basic politeness. Are you planning to comment? I want to share my view, but I'm afraid of being attacked by netizens. Some people simply don't listen to reason. If you want to express a different opinion, you can use the 'affirm first, then negate' technique. This is called tactful expression. 'Affirm first, then negate'? Can you give an example? For example, you can say: 'I very much agree with one point you mentioned, but regarding the part about..., I have a different view.'. This indeed sounds much better than 'you are wrong'. What if I want to say someone's data is erroneous?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字，回應一則你不同意的網絡貼文（可以自訂主題，如：素食、寵物、或是學習方法）。請使用『先肯定，再否定』以及『對事不對人』的原則，展現你的文明與理性。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '不可開交' 形容情況激烈。'對事不對人' 是處理衝突的重要原則。'似乎' 與 '或許' 是弱化語氣、增加禮貌的常用副詞。
examples: 這件事處理得不可開交。 (This matter is being handled inextricably/intensely.)
我們要講道理，對事不對人。 (We should listen to reason, focus on the matter not the person.)
這似乎是最好的解決方案。 (This seems to be the best solution.)
委婉地拒絕 (Tactfully refuse)
文明溝通 (Civilized communication)

practice.q: Translate: Focus on the matter, not the person.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我在你的貼文下面留了言，你看到了嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ zài nǐ de tiē wén xià miàn liú le yán, nǐ yǒu kàn dào ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: I left a comment under your post; did you see it?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 看到了。雖然你的意見跟我相反，但我覺得你寫得很理性，也很專業。
expansion_dialogue.py: kàn dào le. suī rán nǐ de yì jiàn gēn wǒ xiāng fǎn, dàn wǒ jué de nǐ xiě de hěn lǐ xìng, yě hěn zhuān yè.
expansion_dialogue.en: I saw it. Although your opinion is opposite to mine, I feel you wrote very rationally and professionally.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我覺得網路討論應該是為了交流，而不是為了吵架。
expansion_dialogue.py: xiè xie. wǒ jué de wǎng lù tǎo lùn yīng gāi shì wèi le jiāo liú, ér bú shì wèi le chǎo jià.
expansion_dialogue.en: Thanks. I feel internet discussions should be for exchange, not for arguing.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

title: Planning a Small Party
story_description: 馬克的生日快到了，莉莉和大衛提議為他舉辦一個小型的家庭派對。他們正在討論時間、地點、食物和受邀名單。
story_intro: 下週五是馬克的二十歲生日。
莉莉想給他一個驚喜派對。
她找大衛一起分擔籌備工作。
他們決定在莉莉的公寓舉行。
他們需要列出一份清單，確保派對圓滿成功。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 大衛，馬克下週五生日，我們幫他辦個派對吧？我想邀請幾個好朋友來我家。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, mǎ kè xià zhōu wǔ shēng rì, wǒ men bāng tā bàn gè pài duì ba? wǒ xiǎng yāo qǐng jǐ gè hǎo péng you lái wǒ jiā.
dialogue.en: David, Mark's birthday is next Friday; let's host a party for him. I want to invite a few good friends to my house.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好主意！派對的主題是什麼？要辦驚喜派對嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì! pài duì de zhǔ tí shì shén me? yào bàn jīng xǐ pài duì ma?
dialogue.en: Good idea! What's the theme of the party? Shall we host a surprise party?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 對，驚喜派對最有趣了。我們得瞞著他偷偷準備。
dialogue.py: duì, jīng xǐ pài duì zuì yǒu qù le. wǒ men děi mán zhe tā tōu tōu zhǔn bèi.
dialogue.en: Yes, surprise parties are the most fun. We have to hide it from him and prepare secretly.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那受邀名單呢？除了我們兩個，還有誰？
dialogue.py: nà yāo qǐng míng dān ne? chú le wǒ men liǎng gè, hái yǒu shuí?
dialogue.en: What about the guest list? Besides the two of us, who else?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 我想邀請安娜、湯姆還有馬克的室友小林。大約六、七個人，這樣比較溫馨。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng yāo qǐng ān nà, tāng mǔ hái yǒu mǎ kè de shì yǒu xiǎo lín. dà yuē liù, qī gè rén, zhè yàng bǐ jiào wēn xīn.
dialogue.en: I want to invite Anna, Tom, and Mark's roommate Xiaolin. About six or seven people; it's cozier this way.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。那食物方面呢？要自己煮還是訂外送？
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. nà shí wù fāng miàn ne? yào zì jǐ zhǔ hái shì dìng wài sòng?
dialogue.en: No problem. As for food? Shall we cook ourselves or order delivery?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 我打算準備一些簡單的手拿食物，比如小三明治和炸雞翅。飲料我可以調一些無酒精雞尾酒。
dialogue.py: wǒ dǎ suàn zhǔn bèi yī xiē jiǎn dān de shǒu ná shí wù, bǐ rú xiǎo sān míng zhì hé zhá jī chì. yǐn liào wǒ kě yǐ tiáo yī xiē wú jiǔ jīng jī wěi jiǔ.
dialogue.en: I plan to prepare some simple finger foods, like small sandwiches and fried chicken wings. For drinks, I can mix some non-alcoholic cocktails.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很豐盛。那我可以負責訂生日蛋糕和買裝飾品。
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái hěn fēng shèng. nà wǒ kě yǐ fù zé dìng shēng rì dàn gāo hé mǎi zhuāng shì pǐn.
dialogue.en: Sounds very abundant. Then I can be responsible for ordering the birthday cake and buying decorations.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 太好了！氣球和彩帶是必須的。我們還要準備一點背景音樂。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le! qì qiú hé cǎi dài shì bì xū de. wǒ men hái yào zhǔn bèi yī diǎn bèi jǐng yīn lè.
dialogue.en: Great! Balloons and ribbons are a must. We also need to prepare some background music.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。我們要不要玩一些小遊戲？比如交換禮物或者真心話大冒險？
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. wǒ men yào bú yào wán yī xiē xiǎo yóu xì? bǐ rú jiāo huàn lǐ wù huò zhě zhēn xīn huà dà mào xiǎn?
dialogue.en: No problem. Should we play some small games? Like gift exchange or Truth or Dare?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 真心話大冒險可能會太吵，我覺得玩桌遊比較適合。我這裡有幾款很有趣的桌遊。
dialogue.py: zhēn xīn huà dà mào xiǎn kě néng huì tài chǎo, wǒ jué de wán zhuō yóu bǐ jiào shì hé. wǒ zhè lǐ yǒu jǐ kuǎn hěn yǒu qù de zhuō yóu.
dialogue.en: Truth or Dare might be too noisy; I think playing board games is more suitable. I have a few very interesting board games here.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好。那我們來列一下待辦清單，分工合作。
dialogue.py: hǎo. nà wǒ men lái liè yī xià dài bàn qīng dān, fēn gōng hé zuò.
dialogue.en: Okay. Then let's list a to-do list and collaborate with a division of labor.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 我負責發送邀請函和準備食物。你負責蛋糕、飲料和裝飾。OK 嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ fù zé fā sòng yāo qǐng hán hé zhǔn bèi shí wù. nǐ fù zé dàn gāo, yǐn liào hé zhuāng shì. OK ma?
dialogue.en: I'm responsible for sending the invitations and preparing the food. You are responsible for the cake, drinks, and decorations. OK?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 完全沒問題！我們一定要讓馬克過一個難忘的二十歲生日。
dialogue.py: wán quán méi wèn tí! wǒ men yī dìng yào ràng mǎ kè guò yī gè nán wàng de èr shí suì shēng rì.
dialogue.en: Totally no problem! We must let Mark have an unforgettable 20th birthday.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 噓！他回來了，我們先別說了。
dialogue.py: xū! tā huí lái le, wǒ men xiān bié shuō le.
dialogue.en: Shh! He's back; let's stop talking for now.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.en: We told him to meet at the school gate at 7:00, so we have to have everything decorated by 6:30.

title: Surprise Party Problem
story_description: 馬克的驚喜派對正在籌備中，但突然發生了意外：馬克因為忘記拿東西，比預計時間早了三十分鐘回家。莉莉和大衛必須立刻想出辦法。
story_intro: 莉莉和大衛正在佈置派對現場。
蛋糕剛送到，氣球還沒吹完。
這時，莉莉收到室友的消息：馬克正在上樓！
他們陷入了恐慌，因為驚喜差點就要曝光了。
大衛立刻做出決定，試圖拖延時間。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 天啊！大衛，馬克的室友傳訊息說馬克現在正在上樓！
dialogue.py: tiān ā! dà wèi, mǎ kè de shì yǒu chuán xùn xī shuō mǎ kè xiàn zài zhèng zài shàng lóu!
dialogue.en: Oh my god! David, Mark's roommate sent a message saying Mark is coming upstairs right now!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 什麼？他不是說七點才回來嗎？現在才六點半！
dialogue.py: shén me? tā bú shì shuō qī diǎn cái huí lái ma? xiàn zài cái liù diǎn bàn!
dialogue.en: What? Didn't he say he'd be back at 7:00? It's only 6:30 now!

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 聽說他忘了拿錢包。快！氣球還散在地板上，蛋糕也還沒拿出來！
dialogue.py: tīng shuō tā wàng le ná qián bāo. kuài! qì qiú hái sàn zài dì bǎn shàng, dàn gāo yě hái méi ná chū lái!
dialogue.en: I heard he forgot his wallet. Quick! The balloons are still scattered on the floor, and the cake hasn't been taken out yet!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 別慌！我們先把大燈關掉，把門鎖上，假裝家裡沒人。
dialogue.py: bié huāng! wǒ men xiān bǎ dà dēng guān diào, bǎ mén suǒ shàng, jiǎ zhuāng jiā lǐ méi rén.
dialogue.en: Don't panic! Let's first turn off the main lights, lock the door, and pretend no one is home.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 那氣球怎麼辦？來不及收了！
dialogue.py: nà qì qiú zěn me bàn? lái bù jí shōu le!
dialogue.en: What about the balloons? It's too late to pick them up!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 把它們全推到沙發後面！我現在打電話給他，試著拖延時間。
dialogue.py: bǎ tā men quán tuī dào shā fā hòu miàn! wǒ xiàn zài dǎ diàn huà gěi tā, shì zhe tuō yán shí jiān.
dialogue.en: Push them all behind the sofa! I'll call him now and try to stall for time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Phone)
dialogue.zh: 喂？大衛，怎麼了？我剛走到門口。
dialogue.py: wéi? dà wèi, zěn me le? wǒ gāng zǒu dào mén kǒu.
dialogue.en: Hello? David, what's up? I just walked to the door.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 馬克！先別進去！那個...你能不能幫我去巷口的便利商店買一箱可樂？我們今晚要用。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè! xiān bié jìn qù! nà ge... nǐ néng bù néng bāng wǒ qù xiàng kǒu de biàn lì shāng diàn mǎi yī xiāng kě lè? wǒ men jīn wǎn yào yòng.
dialogue.en: Mark! Don't go in yet! Um... can you help me go to the convenience store at the alley entrance to buy a case of cola? We need it tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Phone)
dialogue.zh: 一箱可樂？現在嗎？我剛好想回家拿錢包耶。
dialogue.py: yī xiāng kě lè? xiàn zài ma? wǒ gāng hǎo xiǎng huí jiā ná qián bāo ye.
dialogue.en: A case of cola? Now? I happened to want to go home to get my wallet.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對，很急！你先去買，我等一下下樓幫你搬。求你了！
dialogue.py: duì, hěn jí! nǐ xiān qù mǎi, wǒ děng yī xià xià lóu bāng nǐ bān. qiú nǐ le!
dialogue.en: Yes, it's urgent! You go buy it first, I'll go downstairs later to help you carry it. I beg you!

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Phone)
dialogue.zh: 好啦好啦，真拿你沒辦法。我現在去。
dialogue.py: hǎo la hǎo la, zhēn ná nǐ méi bàn fǎ. wǒ xiàn zài qù.
dialogue.en: Fine, fine, I really can't do anything with you. I'm going now.

dialogue.speaker: Lily (Whisper)
dialogue.zh: 呼...他走了嗎？
dialogue.py: hū... tā zǒu le ma?
dialogue.en: Phew... is he gone?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 走了！我們只有十分鐘。快把氣球黏好，把蠟燭準備好！
dialogue.py: zǒu le! wǒ men zhǐ yǒu shí fèn zhòng. kuài bǎ qì qiú nián hǎo, bǎ là zhú zhǔn bèi hǎo!
dialogue.en: Gone! We only have ten minutes. Quickly stick the balloons up and get the candles ready!

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 大衛，你反應太快了！這次驚喜要是毀了，我一定會哭死。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ fǎn yìng tài kuài le! zhè cì jīng xǐ yào shì huǐ le, wǒ yī dìng huì kū sǐ.
dialogue.en: David, your reaction was so fast! If this surprise were ruined, I would definitely cry to death.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 別說了，動作快！馬克買完可樂很快就會回來的。
dialogue.py: bié shuō le, dòng zuò kuài! mǎ kè mǎi wán kě lè hěn kuài jiù huì huí lái de.
dialogue.en: Stop talking, move fast! Mark will be back very soon after buying the cola.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 加油！三、二、一，開工！
dialogue.py: jiā yóu! sān, èr, yī, kāi gōng!
dialogue.en: Let's go! Three, two, one, start work!

key_sentences.zh: 比預計時間早了三十分鐘。
key_sentences.en: Thirty minutes earlier than the estimated time.
Balloons are still scattered on the floor.
I really can't do anything with you (cannot help but comply).

title: Visiting a Friend’s Family
story_description: 馬克受邀去小林（他的室友）家吃晚餐。這是馬克第一次去台灣人的家裡作客，他希望能表現得禮貌且大方。
story_intro: 小林的媽媽邀請馬克去家裡過節。
馬克特地買了一盒水果作為伴手禮。
他進入小林家時，記得要先脫鞋。
他在餐桌上和小林的父母聊天。
他學習了許多台灣的家庭禮節和禮貌用語。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 阿姨、叔叔好！不好意思打擾了。這是一點小意思，請收下。
dialogue.py: ā yí, shū shu hǎo! bù hǎo yì si dǎ rǎo le. zhè shì yī diǎn xiǎo yì si, qǐng shōu xià.
dialogue.en: Hello Auntie and Uncle! Sorry for disturbing you. This is a small token (of my appreciation); please accept it.

dialogue.speaker: Lin's Mom
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你太客氣了！人來就好了，還帶什麼禮物。快請進。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ tài kè qì le! rén lái jiù hǎo le, hái dài shén me lǐ wù. kuài qǐng jìn.
dialogue.en: Mark, you are too polite! It's enough that you came; why did you bring a gift? Please come in quickly.

dialogue.speaker: Lin's Dad
dialogue.zh: 歡迎歡迎。聽小林說你在學校表現很優秀啊。
dialogue.py: huān yíng huān yíng. tīng xiǎo lín shuō nǐ zài xué xiào biǎo xiàn hěn yōu xiù a.
dialogue.en: Welcome, welcome. I heard from Xiaolin that you perform very excellently at school.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 叔叔過獎了，小林才是我學習的榜樣。他在生活上幫了我很多忙。
dialogue.py: shū shu guò jiǎng le, xiǎo lín cái shì wǒ xué xí de bǎng yàng. tā zài shēng huó shàng bāng le wǒ hěn duō máng.
dialogue.en: Uncle, you flatter me; Xiaolin is the role model for me to learn from. He has helped me a lot in daily life.

dialogue.speaker: Lin's Mom
dialogue.zh: 你們互相照顧是應該的。晚飯準備好了，快來坐。馬克，別客氣，當作自己家一樣。
dialogue.py: nǐ men hù xiāng zhào gù shì yīng gāi de. wǎn fàn zhǔn bèi hǎo le, kuài lái zuò. mǎ kè, bié kè qì, dāng zuò zì jǐ jiā yī yàng.
dialogue.en: It's only right that you take care of each other. Dinner is ready; come sit. Mark, don't be polite (make yourself at home); treat it like your own home.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝阿姨。哇，這一桌菜看起來真豐盛，香味撲鼻！
dialogue.py: xiè xie ā yí. wa, zhè yī zhuō cài kàn qǐ lái zhēn fēng shèng, xiāng wèi pū bí!
dialogue.en: Thank you, Auntie. Wow, this table of dishes looks truly abundant; the fragrance is striking my nose (smells delicious)!

dialogue.speaker: Lin's Mom
dialogue.zh: 只是些家常便飯，不知道合不合你的口味。多吃點魚，這是今天剛買的。
dialogue.py: zhǐ shì xiē jiā cháng biàn fàn, bù zhī dào hé bù hé nǐ de kǒu wèi. duō chī diǎn yú, zhè shì jīn tiān gāng mǎi de.
dialogue.en: It's just some home-cooked food; I don't know if it suits your taste. Eat more fish; this was just bought today.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 非常好吃！阿姨的廚藝真棒，這道紅燒肉做得太入味了。
dialogue.py: fēi cháng hǎo chī! ā yí de chú yì zhēn bàng, zhè dào hóng shāo ròu zuò de tài rù wèi le.
dialogue.en: Extremely delicious! Auntie's cooking skill is great; this braised pork is made so flavorful (the taste has soaked in).

dialogue.speaker: Lin's Dad
dialogue.zh: 馬克，在台灣還習慣嗎？生活上有沒有遇到什麼困難？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, zài tái wān hái xí guàn ma? shēng huó shàng yǒu méi yǒu yù dào shén me kùn nán?
dialogue.en: Mark, are you getting used to Taiwan? Have you encountered any difficulties in life?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 一開始有點不習慣天氣，但現在已經適應了。台灣的人都非常熱情，我很喜歡這裡。
dialogue.py: yī kāi shǐ yǒu diǎn bù xí guàn tiān qì, dàn xiàn zài yǐ jīng shì yìng le. tái wān de rén dōu fēi cháng rè qíng, wǒ hěn xǐ huān zhè lǐ.
dialogue.en: At the beginning I was a bit unaccustomed to the weather, but now I've already adapted. People in Taiwan are all very passionate; I like it here very much.

dialogue.speaker: Lin's Mom
dialogue.zh: 喜歡就好。以後想家了，隨時可以過來吃飯。
dialogue.py: xǐ huān jiù hǎo. yǐ hòu xiǎng jiā le, suí shí kě yǐ guò lái chī fàn.
dialogue.en: As long as you like it. In the future if you miss home, you can come over to eat anytime.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝阿姨，我一定會常來的。阿姨辛苦了，這頓飯我吃得很飽。
dialogue.py: xiè xie ā yí, wǒ yī dìng huì cháng lái de. ā yí xīn kǔ le, zhè dùn fàn wǒ chī de hěn bǎo.
dialogue.en: Thank you, Auntie; I will definitely come often. You've worked hard, Auntie; I've eaten very full this meal.

dialogue.speaker: Lin's Dad
dialogue.zh: 太好了。喝點茶吧，這是阿里山的高山茶。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le. hē diǎn chá ba, zhè shì ā lǐ shān de gāo shān chá.
dialogue.en: Great. Have some tea; this is Alishan high-mountain tea.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝叔叔。今天真的很開心，感謝你們的招待。
dialogue.py: xiè xie shū shu. jīn tiān zhēn de hěn kāi xīn, gǎn xiè nǐ men de zhāo dài.
dialogue.en: Thank you, Uncle. I'm truly happy today; thank you for your hospitality.

dialogue.speaker: Lin's Mom
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。小林，等等送馬克去捷運站。
dialogue.py: bú kè qì. xiǎo lín, děng děng sòng mǎ kè qù jié yùn zhàn.
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Xiaolin, later drop Mark off at the MRT station.

key_sentences.en: This is a small token of my appreciation.
You flatter me / You overpraise me.
Treat it like your own home.

key_sentences.zh: 廚藝真棒，做得太入味了。
key_sentences.en: Cooking skill is great, made very flavorfully.

key_sentences.zh: 已經適應這裡的生活了。
key_sentences.en: Already adapted to the life here.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.py: bú yòng le, wǒ yǒu dài yǔ yī. xiè xie ā yí.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.py: lù shàng xiǎo xīn, dào jiā chuán gè xùn xī shuō yī shēng ō.
expansion_dialogue.en: Be careful on the road; send a message when you get home to let us know.

title: Cultural Manners
story_description: 馬克和小林在去捷運站的路上，討論了台灣和其他國家在餐桌禮儀和社交習慣上的不同。馬克分享了他國家的習俗，小林則介紹了台灣的傳統。
story_intro: 馬克剛從小林家出來，對台灣家庭的熱情印象深刻。
他們開始比較各國的禮貌標準。
馬克發現在台灣吃飯時，長輩先動筷子是很重要的。
小林也好奇美國人在拜訪別人家時有什麼特別的規矩。
他們發現雖然方式不同，但核心都是『尊重』。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 小林，謝謝你今天帶我去你家。你父母真的好熱情，但我剛才在餐桌上很怕失禮。
dialogue.py: xiǎo lín, xiè xie nǐ jīn tiān dài wǒ qù nǐ jiā. nǐ fù mǔ zhēn de hǎo rè qíng, dàn wǒ gāng cái zài cān zhuō shàng hěn pà shī lǐ.
dialogue.en: Xiaolin, thank you for taking me to your house today. Your parents are truly so passionate, but just now at the dining table I was very afraid of being impolite.

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，你表現得很得體。你覺得台灣的餐桌禮儀跟你的國家差很多嗎？
dialogue.py: bié dān xīn, nǐ biǎo xiàn de hěn dé tǐ. nǐ jué de tái wān de cān zhuō lǐ yí gēn nǐ de guó jiā chà hěn duō ma?
dialogue.en: Don't worry, you behaved very appropriately. Do you think Taiwan's table manners are very different from your country's?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有一點。在台灣，似乎要等長輩先動筷子，晚輩才能開始吃，對吧？
dialogue.py: yǒu yī diǎn. zài tái wān, sì hū yào děng zhǎng bèi xiān dòng kuài zi, wǎn bèi cái néng kāi shǐ chī, duì ba?
dialogue.en: A bit. In Taiwan, it seems one has to wait for the elders to move their chopsticks first before the younger generation can start eating, right?

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，這是一種尊重的表現。而且，我們通常不會把筷子直直地插在飯碗裡。
dialogue.py: méi cuò, zhè shì yī zhǒng zūn zhòng de biǎo xiàn. ér qiě, wǒ men tōng cháng bú huì bǎ kuài zi zhí zhí de chā zài fàn wǎn lǐ.
dialogue.en: Exactly, this is an expression of respect. Also, we usually don't stick chopsticks straight into the rice bowl.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 喔？為什麼呢？
dialogue.py: ō? wèi shén me ne?
dialogue.en: Oh? Why is that?

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.zh: 因為那看起來很像祭拜死者的香，非常不吉利。
dialogue.py: yīn wèi nà kàn qǐ lái hěn xiàng jì bài sǐ zhě de xiāng, fēi cháng bù jí lì.
dialogue.en: Because that looks very much like incense for worshipping the dead; it's very inauspicious.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 原來如此，這我一定要記住。在我的國家，吃飯時發出聲音是不禮貌的，但在有些國家似乎沒關係。
dialogue.py: yuán lái rú cǐ, zhè wǒ yī dìng yào jì zhù. zài wǒ de guó jiā, chī fàn shí fā chū shēng yīn shì bù lǐ mào de, dàn zài yǒu xiē guó jiā sì hū méi guān xi.
dialogue.en: I see; I absolutely must remember this. In my country, making noise while eating is impolite, but in some countries it seems okay.

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.zh: 對，文化差異真的很有趣。那如果你們去別人家作客，有什麼規矩嗎？
dialogue.py: duì, wén huà chā yì zhēn de hěn yǒu qù. nà rú guǒ nǐ men qù bié rén jiā zuò kè, yǒu shén me guī ju ma?
dialogue.en: True, cultural differences are really interesting. Then if you guys go to someone's house as a guest, are there any rules?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我們通常會準時到，或者稍微晚一點點，但不可以早到。而且帶一瓶酒或一束花是很常見的。
dialogue.py: wǒ men tōng cháng huì zhǔn shí dào, huò zhě shāo wēi wǎn yī diǎn diǎn, dàn bù kě yǐ zǎo dào. ér qiě dài yī píng jiǔ huò zhě yī shù huā shì hěn cháng jiàn de.
dialogue.en: We usually arrive on time, or slightly a tiny bit late, but you cannot arrive early. Also, bringing a bottle of wine or a bouquet of flowers is very common.

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.zh: 這點跟台灣差不多。不過，在台灣，我們通常會推辭一下禮物，然後才收下。
dialogue.py: zhè diǎn gēn tái wān chà bù duō. bù guò, zài tái wān, wǒ men tōng cháng huì tuī cí yī xià lǐ wù, rán hòu cái shōu xià.
dialogue.en: This point is similar to Taiwan. However, in Taiwan, we usually decline a gift briefly and then accept it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對！阿姨剛才就推辭了好幾次。我還以為她真的不想要呢。
dialogue.py: duì! ā yí gāng cái jiù tuī cí le hǎo jǐ mèi. wǒ hái yǐ wéi tā zhēn de bù xiǎng yào ne.
dialogue.en: Right! Auntie just declined several times. I thought she really didn't want it.

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，那是台灣人的謙虛。不管在世界哪裡，保持謙虛和尊重都是通用的規則。
dialogue.py: hā hā, nà shì tái wān rén de qiān xū. bù guǎn zài shì jiè nǎ lǐ, bǎo chí qiān xū hé zūn zhòng dōu shì tōng yòng de guī zé.
dialogue.en: Haha, that is the modesty of Taiwanese people. No matter where in the world, maintaining modesty and respect are universal rules.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 說得對。多了解對方的文化，才能避免尷尬，交到更多朋友。
dialogue.py: shuō de duì. duō liǎo jiě duì fāng de wén huà, cái néng bì miǎn gān gà, jiāo dào gèng duō péng you.
dialogue.en: Well said. Understanding more of the other's culture is the only way to avoid embarrassment and make more friends.

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。下次換我去你家作客，你再教教我你們國家的規矩。
dialogue.py: méi cuò. xià cì huàn wǒ qù nǐ jiā zuò kè, nǐ zài jiāo jiāo wǒ nǐ men guó jiā de guī ju.
dialogue.en: Exactly. Next time it's my turn to visit your house; you teach me your country's rules then.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 一言為定！
dialogue.py: yī yán wéi dìng!
dialogue.en: It's a deal!

key_sentences.en: Stick chopsticks in the rice bowl.
Declined/pushed back the gift for a moment.
It's a deal! / A promise is a promise!

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你和外國朋友在餐廳吃飯。朋友想把筷子直直地插在碗裡，你立刻阻止他，並解釋在台灣這很不吉利。朋友謝謝你的提醒，並分享了他國家的一個用餐規矩。
part_c: 在你的文化中，有什麼餐桌禮儀是外國人一定要知道的？
你覺得『準時』在你的國家重要嗎？稍微遲到是可以接受的嗎？

comprehension.q: 馬克剛從哪裡出來？
在台灣，吃飯時誰應該先開始？
為什麼不能把筷子插在飯碗裡？
options: B. 因為看起來像祭拜死者的香，不吉利

comprehension.q: 在馬克的國家，去別人家作客通常帶什麼禮物？
小林說台灣人收到禮物時通常會先做什麼？
options: B. 先推辭一下再收下

true_false.q: 小林覺得馬克在餐桌上的表現很失禮。
文化差異是很無聊的事情。
在馬克的國家，吃飯時發出聲音是不禮貌的。
尊重是全球通用的社交規則。

passage.title: Cultural Manners Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克剛從小林家出來，對台灣家庭的熱情印象深刻。他們開始比較各國的禮貌標準。馬克發現在台灣吃飯時，長輩先動筷子是很重要的。小林也好奇美國人在拜訪別人家時有什麼特別的規矩。他們發現雖然方式不同，但核心都是『尊重』。
passage.en: Xiaolin, thank you for taking me to your house today. Your parents are truly so passionate, but just now at the dining table I was very afraid of being impolite. Don't worry, you behaved very appropriately. Do you think Taiwan's table manners are very different from your country's? A bit. In Taiwan, it seems one has to wait for the elders to move their chopsticks first before the younger generation can start eating, right? Exactly, this is an expression of respect. Also, we usually don't stick chopsticks straight into the rice bowl. Oh? Why is that? Because that looks very much like incense for worshipping the dead; it's very inauspicious. I see; I absolutely must remember this. In my country, making noise while eating is impolite, but in some countries it seems okay.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字，比較兩個不同國家的禮儀（例如：餐桌禮儀、送禮習慣或準時觀念）。你覺得了解這些差異對於跨文化溝通有什麼幫助？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '失禮' 與 '得體' 描述社交表現。'不吉利' 是描述禁忌的重要形容詞。'一言為定' 是口語中達成約定的常用語。
examples: 他這麼做真的很失禮。 (It's truly impolite of him to do that.)
這件衣服穿起來很得體。 (This dress looks very appropriate.)
四在台灣是不吉利的數字。 (Four is an unlucky number in Taiwan.)
避免尷尬 (Avoid embarrassment)
互相尊重 (Respect each other)

practice.q: Complete: 他說話不分場合，很失___。 (Impolite.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 在你們國家，見面時通常怎麼打招呼？
expansion_dialogue.py: zài nǐ men guó jiā, jiàn miàn shí tōng cháng zěn me dǎ zhāo hu?
expansion_dialogue.en: In your country, how do you usually greet each other when meeting?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我們通常會握手。如果是很熟的朋友，也會擁抱。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ men tōng cháng huì wò shǒu. rú guǒ shì hěn shú de péng you, yě huì yōng bào.
expansion_dialogue.en: We usually shake hands. If it's a very close friend, we also hug.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 喔，我們通常只是點頭或揮手。如果擁抱，我可能會覺得有點尷尬。
expansion_dialogue.py: ō, wǒ men tōng cháng zhǐ shì diǎn tóu huò huī shǒu. rú guǒ yōng bào, wǒ kě néng huì jué de yǒu diǎn gān gà.
expansion_dialogue.en: Oh, we usually just nod or wave. If hugging, I might feel a bit embarrassed.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這就是文化差異！沒關係，多練習幾次就不會覺得尷尬了。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì wén huà chā yì! méi guān xi, duō liàn xí jǐ mèi jiù bú huì jué de gān gà le.
expansion_dialogue.en: This is exactly cultural difference! It's okay; after practicing a few more times you won't feel embarrassed anymore.

title: Talking About a Movie
story_description: 馬克和莉莉剛在電影院看完一部科幻電影，他們正在回家的路上討論電影的情節、特效以及整體的感受。
story_intro: 馬克和莉莉去看了一部評價很高的科幻大片。
電影院裡座無虛席。
看完後，他們對電影的結局有不同的看法。
馬克非常喜歡電影裡的視覺特效。
莉莉則更關注故事的情節和演員的表現。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 莉莉，你覺得剛才那部電影怎麼樣？我覺得特效簡直太震撼了！
dialogue.py: lì lì, nǐ jué de gāng cái nà bù diàn yǐng zěn me yàng? wǒ jué de tè xiào jiǎn zhí tài zhèn hàn le!
dialogue.en: Lily, what did you think of that movie just now? I think the special effects were simply too shocking/spectacular!

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 特效確實沒話說，特別是宇宙飛船爆炸的那一段。但我對劇情有點失望。
dialogue.py: tè xiào què shí méi huà shuō, tè bié shì yǔ zhòu fēi chuán bào zhà de nà yī duàn. dàn wǒ duì jù qíng yǒu diǎn shī wàng.
dialogue.en: The special effects were indeed beyond words, especially the part where the spaceship exploded. But I was a bit disappointed with the plot.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 失望？為什麼？我覺得節奏很快，從頭到尾都沒有冷場啊。
dialogue.py: shī wàng? wèi shén me? wǒ jué de jié zòu hěn kuài, cóng tóu dào wěi dōu méi yǒu lěng chǎng a.
dialogue.en: Disappointed? Why? I felt the pace was very fast, and there wasn't a dull moment from beginning to end.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 雖然節奏快，但邏輯有點問題。特別是最後男主角的決定，我覺得不太合理。
dialogue.py: suī rán jié zòu kuài, dàn luó jí yǒu diǎn wèn tí. tè bié shì zuì hòu nán zhǔ jiǎo de jué dìng, wǒ jué de bú tài hé lǐ.
dialogue.en: Although the pace was fast, the logic had some problems. Especially the male lead's decision at the end; I feel it wasn't very reasonable.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我倒覺得那是整部電影最感人的地方。他為了拯救地球，犧牲了自己的家庭。
dialogue.py: wǒ dào jué de nà shì zhěng bù diàn yǐng zuì gǎn rén de dì fāng. tā wèi le zhěng jiù dì qiú, xī shēng le zì jǐ de jiā tíng.
dialogue.en: I, on the contrary, felt that was the most touching part of the whole movie. He sacrificed his own family to save the Earth.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 這就是科幻片的典型老套情節。我比較喜歡有新意的結局。
dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì kē huàn piàn de diǎn xíng lǎo tào qíng jié. wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huān yǒu xīn yì de jié jú.
dialogue.en: This is exactly a typical cliché plot of sci-fi movies. I prefer endings with originality.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好吧，每個人看電影的重點不一樣。不過你不得不承認，演員的演技都很到位。
dialogue.py: hǎo ba, měi gè rén kàn diàn yǐng de zhòng diǎn bù yī yàng. bù guò nǐ bù dé bù chéng rèn, yǎn yuán de yǎn jì dōu dōu dào wèi.
dialogue.en: Fine, everyone's focus when watching a movie is different. But you have to admit, the actors' acting was all very spot-on.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 這點我同意。女主角把那種絕望的感覺演得淋漓盡致。
dialogue.py: zhè diǎn wǒ tóng yì. nǚ zhǔ jiǎo bǎ nà zhǒng jué wàng de gǎn jué yǎn de lín lí jìn zhì.
dialogue.en: I agree with this point. The female lead performed that feeling of despair to the fullest.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 如果是滿分十分的話，你會給這部電影打幾分？
dialogue.py: rú guǒ shì mǎn fēn shí fēn de huà, nǐ huì gěi zhè bù diàn yǐng dǎ jǐ fēn?
dialogue.en: If it were out of ten, how many points would you give this movie?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 看在演技和特效的份上，我給七分。你呢？
dialogue.py: kàn zài yǎn jì hé tè xiào de fèn shàng, wǒ gěi qī fēn. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: For the sake of the acting and special effects, I'll give it a seven. You?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我給九分！我已經好久沒看過這麼精彩的電影了。我打算明天再去看一次 3D 版的。
dialogue.py: wǒ gěi jiǔ fēn! wǒ yǐ jīng hǎo jiǔ méi kàn guò zhè me jīng cǎi de diàn yǐng le. wǒ dǎ suàn míng tiān zài qù kàn yī mèi 3D bǎn de.
dialogue.en: I'll give it a nine! I haven't seen such a wonderful movie in a long time. I plan to go see the 3D version again tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 你真是個科幻迷。對了，這部電影的配樂也很好聽，很有代入感。
dialogue.py: nǐ zhēn shì gè kē huàn mí. duì le, zhè bù diàn yǐng de pèi yuè yě hěn hǎo tīng, hěn yǒu dài rù gǎn.
dialogue.en: You really are a sci-fi fan. By the way, the soundtrack of this movie is also very nice; it really pulls you in.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，音樂一響起我就全身起雞皮疙瘩。非常有渲染力。
dialogue.py: duì, yīn lè yī xiǎng qǐ wǒ jiù quán shēn qǐ jī pí gē da. fēi cháng yǒu xuàn rǎn lì.
dialogue.en: Yes, as soon as the music started playing, I got goosebumps all over. Very infectious/expressive.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 那我們去吃宵夜吧，邊吃邊聊。我突然覺得肚子餓了。
dialogue.py: nà wǒ men qù chī xiāo yè ba, biān chī biān liáo. wǒ tū rán jué de dù zi è le.
dialogue.en: Then let's go have late-night snacks and talk while eating. I suddenly feel hungry.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我知道這附近有一家不錯的拉麵店。走吧！
dialogue.py: hǎo a, wǒ zhī dào zhè fù jìn yǒu yī jiā bú cuò de lā miàn diàn. zǒu ba!
dialogue.en: Sure, I know a good ramen shop nearby. Let's go!

key_sentences.en: The special effects were simply too shocking!
I'm a bit disappointed with the plot.
The pace is fast, no dull moments.
The actors' acting was all very spot-on.
Very immersive / Really pulls you in.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你和朋友剛看完一部動作片。你覺得打鬥場面很精彩，但朋友覺得劇情太簡單。你們互相討論對電影的評分，並決定去吃點東西。
part_c: 你最近看過最精彩的電影是什麼？請簡單描述一下內容。
你喜歡看什麼類型的電影？科幻、愛情、恐怖還是動作片？

電影的配樂非常有代入感，讓人起雞皮疙瘩。

passage.title: Talking About a Movie Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克和莉莉去看了一部評價很高的科幻大片。電影院裡座無虛席。看完後，他們對電影的結局有不同的看法。馬克非常喜歡電影裡的視覺特效。莉莉則更關注故事的情節和演員的表現。
passage.en: Lily, what did you think of that movie just now? I think the special effects were simply too shocking/spectacular! The special effects were indeed beyond words, especially the part where the spaceship exploded. But I was a bit disappointed with the plot. Disappointed? Why? I felt the pace was very fast, and there wasn't a dull moment from beginning to end. Although the pace was fast, the logic had some problems. Especially the male lead's decision at the end; I feel it wasn't very reasonable. I, on the contrary, felt that was the most touching part of the whole movie. He sacrificed his own family to save the Earth. This is exactly a typical cliché plot of sci-fi movies. I prefer endings with originality. Fine, everyone's focus when watching a movie is different. But you have to admit, the actors' acting was all very spot-on.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字，寫一篇短評。介紹一部你最近看的電影，並說明你喜歡或不喜歡的原因（可以討論特效、劇情、演技或配樂）。你推薦別人去看嗎？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '簡直 (jiǎn zhí)' 表達強烈的語氣，相當於 'simply/literally'。'淋漓盡致' 形容發揮得極其充分。'看在...的份上' 用於給予某種考慮的理由。
examples: 他簡直是個天才。 (He is simply a genius.)
這場比賽他發揮得淋漓盡致。 (He performed to the fullest in this match.)
看在他是新手的份上，原諒他吧。 (For the sake of him being a novice, forgive him.)
起雞皮疙瘩 (Get goosebumps)
劇情老套 (Cliche plot)

practice.q: Complete: 他把角色演得___漓盡致。 (To the fullest.)
Translate: For the sake of acting.
Complete: 電影配樂很有代___感。 (Sense of immersion.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你覺得新出的那部恐怖片怎麼樣？我一直不敢去看。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ jué de xīn chū de nà bù kǒng bù piàn zěn me yàng? wǒ yī zhí bù gǎn qù kàn.
expansion_dialogue.en: What do you think of the new horror movie? I've been afraid to go see it.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 特效做得很逼真，音效也很嚇人。但我看一半就猜到結局了。
expansion_dialogue.py: tè xiào zuò de hěn bì zhēn, yīn xiào yě hěn xià rén. dàn wǒ kàn yī bàn jiù cāi dào jié jú le.
expansion_dialogue.en: The special effects are very realistic, and the sound effects are very scary. But I guessed the ending halfway through.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 所以不推薦囉？
expansion_dialogue.py: suǒ yǐ bù tuī jiàn luo?
expansion_dialogue.en: So you don't recommend it?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 如果你喜歡追求刺激，還是值得一看的。但如果你追求劇情的深度，可能會失望。
expansion_dialogue.py: rú guǒ nǐ xǐ huān zhuī qiú cì jī, hái shì zhí de yī kàn de. dàn rú guǒ nǐ zhuī qiú jù qíng de shēn dù, kě néng huì shī wàng.
expansion_dialogue.en: If you like chasing excitement, it's still worth watching. But if you pursue depth of plot, you might be disappointed.
